我明白了。
也許渡輪可以再次起航了...
感謝你們為我們所做的一切。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I'd better get ready to set sail then.
It's not much, but this is for you.
If we can get back in business, I'll take you to Izlude for just 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
那我得準備起航了。
雖然不多，但這是給你的。
如果我們恢復運營，我只收你1000 Zeny就能帶你去依斯魯得島。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
If you want to go to Alberta, use the big ship over there.
This little one goes to Izlude.
That will be 1000z.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
如果你想去艾爾貝塔，請使用那邊的大船。
這艘小船隻去依斯魯得島。
費用是1000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Use.
scripts.translation: 使用

scripts.text: That's a rip off!
scripts.translation: 太貴了！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
What?!
How much do you pay for the Alberta Liner to get here!?
Call this a rip off... You think I'm doing charity?
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
什麼？！
你去艾爾貝塔的渡輪要付多少錢？！
說這太貴...你以為我在做慈善嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
The price is 1000 zeny.
I can't help you there~
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
價格是1000 Zeny。
我幫不了你~

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Thank you~
Let's go before the ghosts come back!
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
謝謝~
在幽靈回來之前，我們快走吧！

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
You know what to do.
Gather the flowers and take it to Mumbaki to get an Offering Bouquet made.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
你知道該怎麼做。
去採集花朵，然後交給蒙巴基製作供奉用花束。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Give the Bouquet to Miss Diwata to cheer her up.
....Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
把花束交給迪瓦塔小姐，讓她開心起來。
...謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Diwata is calm!
I can even feel the difference out here.
I am always in your debt.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
迪瓦塔平靜下來了！
我甚至能感覺到這裡的氛圍變了。
我欠你一個人情。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
You know what? Why don't you do this on a more regular basis?
I think you kind of like doing it.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
你知道嗎？你不妨經常這麼做。
我覺得你挺喜歡做這件事的。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Ah, the thing is...
We can't go right now..
You see, the ghosts are back...
I'm fed up with nuisance.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
啊，問題是...
我們現在不能過去...
你看，幽靈又回來了...
我受夠了這種麻煩。

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I mean... Miss Diwata... Isn't feeling very well and, even with the Spiritual Protection
a normal person can't stand it.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
我是說...迪瓦塔小姐...身體很不舒服，即使有護身符，普通人也無法忍受。

scripts.text: I see. Take care then.
scripts.translation: 我明白了。那你保重。

scripts.text: How about a Floral Tribute?
scripts.translation: 獻上花束如何？

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
I'm glad you understand.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
很高興你能理解。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Pedro the Sailor]
Hmmm. That would be nice.
If she can be soothed with flowers...!
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[水手 佩德羅]
嗯。那也不錯。
如果花能安撫她...！
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
- A creepy Little Girl is standing.
As our eyes meet, a chill runs down my spine with goose bumps all over. -
scripts.translation:
- 一個詭異的小女孩站在那裡。
當我們的目光相遇時，一股寒意順著我的脊背爬上來，全身起雞皮疙瘩。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Are you here to bully Diwata too?
I won't have it!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你是來欺負迪瓦塔的嗎？
我不允許！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's low creepy voice and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 我被小女孩低沉詭異的聲音和眼中的閃光震飛了出去。 -

scripts.text:
- A creepy Little Girl is standing.
As our eyes meet, a chill runs down my spine with goose bumps all over. -
scripts.translation:
- 一個詭異的小女孩站在那裡。
當我們的目光相遇時，一股寒意順著我的脊背爬上來，全身起雞皮疙瘩。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Are you here to bully Diwata too?
I won't have it!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你是來欺負迪瓦塔的嗎？
我不允許！

scripts.text: Wait! I just want to talk!
scripts.translation: 等等！我只是想談談！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Then who are they behind you?
You're one of them!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
那你身後的是誰？
你是他們一夥的！

scripts.text: - Familiar souls are approaching Diwata. -
scripts.translation: - 使魔的靈魂正逼近迪瓦塔。 -

scripts.text: It's a misunderstanding!
scripts.translation: 這是個誤會！

scripts.text: You're from that..!
scripts.translation: 你是從那裡來的..！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Just as I thought! You're afraid of me?!
Stand aside!
I need to talk to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
果然如此！你怕我？！
讓開！
我需要和她談談。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
I don't know why they're backing away...
You get out of my sight too!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
我不知道他們為什麼在後退...
你也從我眼前消失！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's annoyed cry and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 在小女孩憤怒的喊叫和眼中閃爍的光芒中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Enough!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
夠了！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's resolute cry and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 在小女孩堅定的喊叫和眼中閃爍的光芒中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
You crawled back in?
Get out-!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你又爬回來了？
給我滾出去——！！！！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out after the Little Girl's screeching cry and flash from her eyes.-
scripts.translation: - 在小女孩尖銳的喊叫和眼中閃爍的光芒中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
- The soul of Little Girl Diwata is looking at me fiercely.
No Offering Bouquet...!!!
scripts.translation:
- 小女孩迪瓦塔的靈魂正凶狠地盯著我。
沒有供奉用花束...！！！

scripts.text: -I was thrown out with a remote look from her.-
scripts.translation: - 在她冷漠的目光中，我被扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
- The soul of Little Girl Diwata is looking at me fiercely. -
- The Offering Bouquet... -
scripts.translation:
- 小女孩迪瓦塔的靈魂正凶狠地盯著我。 -
- 供奉用花束... -

scripts.text: Throw it to the Little Girl.
scripts.translation: 把花束扔給小女孩。

scripts.text: Slide it across on the floor.
scripts.translation: 把花束在地上滑過去。

scripts.text:
- I threw the bouquet before she could toss me out, and she catches in surprise...
She won't toss me... far, now that she has the flower.-
scripts.translation:
- 在她把我扔出去之前，我扔出了花束，她驚訝地接住了...
既然她有了花，就不會把我扔得太遠了。

scripts.text: - I slid the flower across the floor to her. She looks puzzled. -
scripts.translation: - 我把花在地上滑到她面前。她看起來很困惑。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What is the meaning of this?
You're not an enemy?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
這是什麼意思？
你不是敵人？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What? You're an outsider too?
Ha, so live ones are allowed and I'm not?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
什麼？你也是外人？
哈，所以活人是可以進來的，而我卻不行？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Now there's the stereotype of countryside people over outsiders.
I am so annoyed. I feel like wiping them off the map.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
真是鄉下人對外人的刻板印象。
我真的很煩。真想讓他們從地圖上消失。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What? I shouldn't?
Why should I not?
I'm stalling the ship?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
什麼？我不應該這樣？
為什麼我不應該？
是我在阻礙船隻嗎？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
I was going to hear you out because of the flowers
but you're telling me lies?!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
我本來想因為花而聽你解釋
結果你卻在騙我？！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
So you're saying that I brought these hillbillies on this ship
and that fighting with them is causing the stall?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
所以你是說，是我把這些鄉下人帶上船的
而且和他們打架導致了船隻停滯？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... Hmm... Humph. It wasn't what I was intending to do.
But they're the ones who're getting on my nerves!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 嗯... 哼。這不是我的本意。
但是是他們讓我心煩意亂！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... I can't get off anyway.
Which means that I could feel bad again. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 反正我也下不了船。
這意味著我可能會再次感到難過。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... I'll try to keep it in today.
It's not because I like the flowers or because I like having company!
It's because I was treated the same way as those cheap ghosts!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 我今天會盡量忍耐的。
不是因為我喜歡花，也不是因為我喜歡有人陪伴！
是因為我被像那些低賤的幽靈一樣對待了！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Now if you'll excuse me.
And I'll be clear. I'm not going to hold my temper for so long.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
好了，請回吧。
我要說清楚。我不會一直壓抑我的脾氣。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Now, g... go away!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
現在，走... 快走開！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
I promise I'll be a good little girl if those hillbillies leave me alone.
If they bother me again, however, I won't be.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
我保證，如果那些鄉下人不再打擾我，我會做個乖女孩。
但如果他們再來惹我，我就不保證了。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Surprisingly enough, I'm doing fine.
Of course I'm tense for when they return,
but, as always, I'll win.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
出乎意料的是，我過得還不錯。
當然，一想到他們可能會回來，我就很緊張，
但一如既往，我會贏的。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Then the poor crew will cry again
I just can't calm myself down after a fight.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
那樣可憐的水手們又要哭了。
每次打架之後，我都無法讓自己平靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
The flowers you bring makes me calm down.
....
.. It's not because I miss people or I like the flowers. Don't take it the wrong way.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你帶來的花讓我平靜下來。
....
.. 不是因為我想念人類，也不是因為我喜歡花。別誤會。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Get lost!
What? Oh, it's you.
Those hillbillies came back again!
I'm going to kill them!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
滾開！
什麼？哦，是你啊。
那些鄉下人又回來了！
我要殺了他們！

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
It's good to look at flowers from abroad~
Do all flowers from the warm parts of the world smell so nice?
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
看看來自異國的花真不錯~
所有來自溫暖地區的花都這麼香嗎？

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
The flowers you bring makes me calm down.
....
.. It's not because I miss people or I like the flowers. Don't take it the wrong way.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你帶來的花讓我平靜下來。
....
.. 不是因為我想念人類，也不是因為我喜歡花。別誤會。

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Darn it! Have you come for more?!
What?
Oh. It's you?
I'm really depressed right now.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
該死！你是來要更多的嗎？！
什麼？
哦。是你啊？
我現在真的很沮喪。

scripts.text: - Diwata reached her hands out as if expecting something. -
scripts.translation: - 迪瓦塔伸出手，彷彿在期待什麼。 -

scripts.text: Give the Bouquet.
scripts.translation: 遞上花束

scripts.text: Hold her hand.
scripts.translation: 握住她的手

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What do you think you're doing?!!??!?!!
Arghhhh - I have enough creeps around here, thank you!!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
你想幹什麼？！！？？！？！
啊——這裡已經夠多討厭鬼了，謝謝！！

scripts.text: -I was tossed out with Diwata's thunderous cry.-
scripts.translation: - 我被迪瓦塔的一聲怒吼扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
What? You want me to wave?
You didn't bring it?
You didn't?!?
Arghhh you just can't trust anybody! Anybody!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
什麼？你想讓我揮手？
你沒帶花來？
你沒帶？！？
啊——真是什麼人都不能信！誰都不能信！

scripts.text: -I was tossed out with Diwata's thunderous cry.-
scripts.translation: - 我被迪瓦塔的一聲怒吼扔了出去。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
... Oh... Just as I thought!
My only happiness, my only peace of mind..!
Flowers from abroad~!
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
... 哦... 果然如此！
我唯一的幸福，我唯一的安寧..！
來自異國的花~！

scripts.text: -Diwata seems to feel better. The atmosphere shifts to a more refreshing ambience.-
scripts.translation: - 迪瓦塔似乎感覺好多了。氣氛變得清新起來。 -

scripts.text:
[Diwata]
Tell Pedro the Sailor!
Diwata will be a goddess of sea, so set sail in my generosity.
scripts.translation:
[迪瓦塔]
告訴水手佩德羅！
迪瓦塔將成為海上的女神，所以請帶著我的慷慨揚帆起航吧。

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 無法繼續任務。您攜帶的物品過多。-

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Welcome to Baryo, stranger.
I am the soul guidance, protector of people and souls here at Baryo.
So, I'm a good leader Kiko in Mumbaki.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
歡迎來到巴里奧，陌生人。
我是這裡的靈魂嚮導，守護著巴里奧的人們和靈魂。
所以，我是個好領導，蒙巴基的奇科。

scripts.text: Give Cast-Iron Caldron.
scripts.translation: 交出生鐵做的鍋

scripts.text: Request Purification Ritual.
scripts.translation: 請求淨化儀式

scripts.text: Exchange Jellopy for gold.
scripts.translation: 用傑勒比結晶換金幣

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
What cauldron?
As far as I know, you're not the one bringing it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
什麼鍋？
據我所知，你並不是那個送鍋的人。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Poor thing.
do not live a life of lies.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
可憐的傢伙。
不要活在謊言中。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Baryo is not a great place for smithy work.
So we always ask a favor to the forge of Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
巴里奧並不是適合鐵匠工作的地方。
所以我們總是請求馬拉亞的鐵匠幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Bakonawa does not like loud noises.
That's why we beat the sturdy Cast Iron Cauldrons.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
巴庫暴龍不喜歡吵鬧的聲音。
所以我們總是敲打結實的生鐵做的鍋。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
The Spiritual Protection is proof that I've got my cauldron,
so deliver it well. Okay? Good.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
護身符是我拿到鍋的證明，
所以請好好保管它。好嗎？很好。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Oh, must be the cauldron I ordered.
But, where is it?
Are you mocking me?!
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
哦，那應該是我訂的鍋。
但是，它在哪裡？
你在嘲笑我嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Yes, excellent!
Very Good.
We can aggravate the Bakonawa more with this.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
是的，太棒了！
非常好。
我們可以用這個讓巴庫暴龍更生氣。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
I'll give you this for the cauldron.
I hear you're having some trouble with souls?
Take this. It will help you.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
我把這個給你作為鍋的報酬。
聽說你在靈魂方面有些麻煩？
拿著這個。它會幫到你的。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
The only purification needed in this village is Vantai's food.
There are no rituals where an outsider, like yourself, can take part in.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
這個村莊唯一需要淨化的是萬泰的食物。
沒有外人像你這樣能參加的儀式。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Vantai must be hungry.
Go give it to him.
Quickly now.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
萬泰一定餓了。
快去給他吃。
快點。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Purification of the bones the Guard Dog Vantai needs to gnaw on?
My work here just gets better and better.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
淨化衛兵萬泰需要啃的骨頭？
我的工作越來越好了。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Go into the forest and fetch me ^4d4dff10 Evil Spirit Bones^000000 and ^4d4dff10 Holy Waters^000000 for the purification ritual.
I'll do the ritual myself.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
去森林裡給我拿^4d4dff10惡靈之骨^000000和^4d4dff10聖水^000000來淨化儀式。
我會親自進行儀式。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Bones from the animals of this forest all have bad spirits within.
Of course it cannot be helped due to the malignant spirits flailing about...
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
這片森林裡的動物骨頭都帶有邪惡的靈魂。
當然，由於邪惡靈魂的肆虐，這是不可避免的...

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
You do this and do this here and there and...
There. The evil spirit has left and the bone is so pure that you can just chew on it.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
你在這裡做這個，在那裡做那個...
好了。邪惡的靈魂已經離開了，骨頭變得如此純淨，你可以直接啃了。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Now, take this back to Dong the Guard.
Vantai will become stronger after eating this purified Evil Spirit Bone.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
現在，把這個拿回給衛兵東。
萬泰吃了這塊淨化的惡靈之骨後會變得更強。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Moreover, holding on to Evil Spirit Bones will only do you harm,
so I'll take them all to purify.
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
而且，持有惡靈之骨只會對你有害，
所以我會把它們全部拿去淨化。

scripts.text:
[Kiko in Mumbaki]
Oh no you don't!
Don't you dare!
scripts.translation:
[蒙巴基的 奇科]
不，你不行！
你不敢！

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 無法繼續任務。您攜帶的物品過多。-

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Hi there!
Welcome to Baryo.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
你好！
歡迎來到巴里奧。

scripts.text: You're job seems so hard~
scripts.translation: 你的工作看起來好辛苦~

scripts.text: Guard Dog Vantai
scripts.translation: 看門狗 萬泰

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Not at all. I just watch who comes and goes from here.
Travelers are the ones who go through more hardship.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
一點也不辛苦。我只是在這裡看著誰進誰出。
反而是旅行者要經歷更多的艱辛。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Vantai is a nice dog.
He's probably stronger than you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
萬泰是一隻很棒的狗。
它可能比你還要強。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
No offense, but
you look weaker than the original owners of the bones Vantai chews on.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
別介意，
但你看起來比萬泰啃的那些骨頭的原主人還要弱。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
That means just about as strong as me!
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
也就是說，你大概和我一樣強！
哈哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
The bones you brought Vantai gave him a feast.
He'll be full and merry for a while now.
Nobody can beat Vantai in recon around here.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
你帶給萬泰的骨頭讓它大飽口福。
它現在心滿意足，精神得很。
在這一帶，沒人能在偵察方面勝過萬泰。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Though it is not nice to say a person is lesser than a dog,
but there are some who are lesser.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
雖然把人和狗比較不太禮貌，
但確實有些人不如狗。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Vantai?
Always the same.
Now that you mention it, it's almost time for him to get hungry.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
萬泰？
老樣子。
說起來，它差不多該餓了。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Of course, he eats normal dog food, but he can't go without those.
You know what I mean, right?
Smirk...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
當然，它也吃普通的狗糧，但它離不開那些東西。
你懂我意思吧？
嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Me and Vantai are always waiting
for the hero to get us some Evil Spirit Bones from the forest.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
我和萬泰一直在等英雄從普勒斯特森林給我們帶些惡靈之骨回來。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
What I'm saying is that, to be a good guard dog, he must be able to stand ground against evil spirits.
For that he needs to eat Evil Spirit Bones, but it must be purified before he can eat them.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
我的意思是，要成為一隻好的看門狗，它必須能抵禦邪惡靈魂。
為此它需要吃惡靈之骨，但在吃之前必須先淨化。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
You can get Evil Spirit Bones from monsters or animals in the forest.
Kiko in Mumbaki will purify them for you.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
你可以從普勒斯特森林的魔物或動物身上獲得惡靈之骨。
蒙巴基的 奇科會幫你淨化它們。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Kiko in Mumbaki asked for 10 Purified Spirit Bones.
He needs to have at least 10 at a time. Which of course does not last a day...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
蒙巴基的 奇科需要10塊淨化靈魂之骨。
他每次至少需要10塊。當然，這根本不夠吃一天的...

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Hey, Vantai will love these!
It's all in good condition...
An evil bone purified through holy ritual...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
嘿，萬泰會喜歡這些的！
它們狀態都很好...
經過神聖儀式淨化的惡靈之骨...

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
This is the perfect dog food!!
Now he can sense and detect evil spirits,
and since he ate purified ones, he'll get the ability to eradicate them.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
這是完美的狗糧！！
現在它能感知和獵鷹尋敵邪惡靈魂，
而且因為吃了淨化的骨頭，它還能獲得消滅它們的能力。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
I bet he's the strongest living thing in the village now.
Of course not me. I mean Vantai.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
我敢打賭，它現在是村莊裡最強的生物。
當然不包括我。我是說萬泰。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
This is your reward.
It would be very nice if you could help us again tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
這是你的獎勵。
如果你明天能再幫我們要一次，那就太棒了。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Vantai is not only a guard dog, but he's also a great detector and recon scout.
But for him to do so, he needs to eat Purified Spirit Bones.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
萬泰不僅是一隻看門狗，它還是出色的探測者和偵察兵。
但要做到這些，它需要吃淨化靈魂之骨。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
As you can see, I can't move from here,
so I was wondering if you can get the bones for Vantai...
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
你也看到了，我走不開，
所以想問問你能不能幫萬泰弄些骨頭...

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
I see.
Vantai!
No treat for you today..!!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
我明白了。
萬泰！
今天沒有你的零食了..!!

scripts.text: - It seems like Vantai's eyes are more moist today. -
scripts.translation: - 看起來萬泰今天的眼神更加溼潤了。 -

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Bones can be acquired from animals or monsters around here.
Take them to Kiko in Mumbaki for purification, which, in turn, can be given to Vantai to eat.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
骨頭可以從附近的動物或魔物身上獲取。
把它們交給蒙巴基的奇科進行淨化，之後就可以給萬泰吃了。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Bring us 10 Purified Spirit Bones.
That reminds me. You'll need Holy Water for the purification ritual.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
請給我們帶來10個淨化靈魂之骨。
對了。淨化儀式需要用到聖水。

scripts.text:
[Dhong the Guard]
Take your time.
Look here. Vantai likes it too.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵 東]
請慢慢來。
看這裡。萬泰也很喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Vantai]
Grrrrrrr...
 
(He is intimidated by you.)
scripts.translation:
[萬泰]
Grrrrrrr...
 
(它對你感到畏懼。)

scripts.text: - Cannot proceed with the quest. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 無法繼續任務。您攜帶的物品過多。-

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Umm... Hey...
Oh, no, sorry. You don't look so strong or bold.
I'm sorry. I'm just not quite myself...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
嗯... 嘿...
啊，不，抱歉。你看起來並不強壯或勇敢。
對不起。我有點不太對勁...

scripts.text: An anxious looking woman is stands.
scripts.translation: 一位神情焦慮的女子站在那裡。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Now that the children know that they can get back home with an Inside-out Shirt,
they play out in the forest recklessly and timelessly.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
既然孩子們知道只要穿著反穿的襯衫就能回家，
他們就在森林裡肆無忌憚、沒日沒夜地玩耍。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
The children will surely get lost again in these conditions.
If it happens again, I'll seek your help again.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
在這種狀況下，孩子們肯定會再次迷路。
如果再次發生，我會再次尋求你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
I'm missing a child... again.
Oh my goodness...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
我又少了一個孩子...
天哪...

scripts.text:
[Maries]
You came back.
Thanks to you, the child has returned home safely.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
你回來了。
多虧了你，孩子已經安全回家了。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Although the shirt is inside-out, it miraculously brings them back to where they should be.
Thank you for delivering those precious shirts to my children.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
雖然襯衫是反穿的，但它奇蹟般地能讓他們回到該在的地方。
謝謝你把那些珍貴的襯衫送到我的孩子們手中。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
I'm sure they're lost in the woods because of mischievous spirits.
Please give the child the ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 when found.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
我確信他們是因為調皮的精靈而在樹林裡迷路了。
找到孩子時，請給他們^4d4dff反穿的襯衫^000000。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
The Inside-out Shirts...
You can probably get them from the demons, since they ran away with them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
反穿的襯衫...
既然惡魔把它們搶走了，你應該能從惡魔那裡拿到。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Hello... I'm looking for my child...
My daughter did not return.
Please help, I think she's lost in the forest.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
你好... 我在找我的孩子...
我的女兒沒有回來。
請幫幫我，我想她在森林裡迷路了。

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: I'm too busy right now.
scripts.translation: 我現在太忙了。

scripts.text: You have so many children.
scripts.translation: 你有這麼多孩子。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
I'm sure she's lost in the woods because of mischievous spirits.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
我確信她是因為調皮的精靈而在樹林裡迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
If she's cursed, it will be difficult to get her out of there.
She'll drift around in the maze so mesmerizing, even for you, in fact.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
如果她被詛咒了，想把她帶出來就會很困難。
她會在迷宮中迷失方向，那種迷惑力非常強大，甚至對你也是如此。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
Acquire an ^4d4dffInside-out Shirt^000000 and give it to my daughter.
Although the shirt is inside-out, it miraculously brings them back to where they should be.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
請獲取一件^4d4dff反穿的襯衫^000000，並把它交給我的女兒。
雖然這件襯衫是反穿的，但它有奇蹟般的效果，能讓他們回到該去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
The Inside-out Shirts...
You can probably get them from the demons, since they ran away with them.
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
反穿的襯衫...
既然惡魔把它們搶走了，你應該能從惡魔那裡拿到。

scripts.text:
[Maries]
... Yes... I see.
I'll have to ask someone else.
Alright.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
...是的...我明白了。
看來我得找別人幫忙了。
好吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Maries]
...I ended up having triplets.
Even I sometimes get confused. *Chuckle*
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
...我竟然生了三胞胎。
連我自己有時候都會搞混。*輕笑*

scripts.text:
[Maries]
They seem to be under a curse because one of them always get's lost in the woods..
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[瑪麗埃斯]
她們似乎中了詛咒，因為其中一個總是在樹林裡迷路。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
He he, the forest is scary, but it's so much fun so I go there often to play~
Strange, how we always get lost.
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
呵呵，森林雖然有點可怕，但非常有趣，所以我經常去那裡玩~
奇怪，為什麼我們總是迷路呢。

scripts.text:
[Little Girl]
But it's okay because I'm not the only one getting lost~
We're triplets~ And we're missing the other two~ Giggle~
scripts.translation:
[小女孩]
不過沒關係，因為迷路的不止我一個~
我們是三胞胎~另外兩個也不見了~嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Sigh. Are you lost too?
They are so naughty.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
唉。你也迷路了嗎？
她們真調皮。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
An Inside-out Shirt is just what I need.
*Chuckle*...
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
一件反穿的襯衫正是我需要的。
*輕笑*...

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Oh, darn them.
They must have tricked me into getting lost again!
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
哎呀，真是的。
她們肯定又騙我，讓我再次迷路了！

scripts.text: Do you want to go home?
scripts.translation: 你想回家嗎？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
If I don't get back soon, my mom will be worried sick.
Sigh... I wish I had an Inside-out Shirt to go back.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
如果我不快點回去，媽媽會擔心壞的。
唉...要是有一件反穿的襯衫能帶我回去就好了。

scripts.text: Here you are.
scripts.translation: 給你。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Really?
It really is the shirt!
This will take me straight home!
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
真的嗎？
這真的是那件襯衫！
它能直接帶我回家！

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Did mom send you?
She must be worried..!
I'll go home now!
Thanks' a lot!
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
是媽媽派你來的嗎？
她一定很擔心...！
我現在就回家！
太感謝你了！

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
I want to play some more.
I can always go back with this shirt.
Mom won't be concerned.
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
我還想再玩一會兒。
反正有這件襯衫隨時都能回去。
媽媽不會擔心的。

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Hmmm. Am I lost again?
Where am I...
I'm sure I have to head in the direction of sunrise from the third tree to get home... Huh?
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
嗯...我又迷路了嗎？
我在哪裡...
我記得要從第三棵樹往日出方向走才能回家...咦？

scripts.text:
[Little Kid]
Why~ Do I always go in circles here?
Do you why, {0}?
What's with this road?
Is somebody trying to trick me?
scripts.translation:
[小孩子]
為什麼~我在這裡總是繞圈圈？
你知道嗎，{0}？
這條路怎麼回事？
是不是有人在捉弄我？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey hey hey~
I am such a nice Capre~ Hey!
I am going to a fine cafe~YO!
I am better than yesterday~Hey!
I'm a fine rhyming Capre~Oh?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿~嘿~嘿~
我是多麼善良的卡普雷~嘿！
我要去一家很棒的咖啡館~喲！
我比昨天更棒了~嘿！
我是個會押韻的卡普雷~哦？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey buddy, You here to hear Budidai singing?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿，夥計，你是來聽布迪代唱歌的嗎？

scripts.text: You like songs?
scripts.translation: 你喜歡唱歌嗎？

scripts.text: A profound study of one eyed monsters.
scripts.translation: 關於獨眼魔物的深入研究

scripts.text: See ya!
scripts.translation: 再見！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Yup, Budidai loves singing.
Cows, horses, goats, roosters, boars all love my songs.
They're all friends.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
沒錯，布迪代喜歡唱歌。
奶牛、馬、山羊、公雞、野豬都喜歡我的歌。
它們都是我的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Except for that one eyed Bongisungisu.
He picks on my friends.
I am annoyed, but Budidai is weak.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
除了那個獨眼的邦吉松吉蘇。
它欺負我的朋友。
我很生氣，但布迪代很弱。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
I fear it's single gaze, but I fear more the club he flails.
I have to sing my friends some songs, but they don't come because of him.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
我害怕它那隻獨眼，但更害怕它揮舞的棍棒。
我想給朋友們唱歌，但因為它的緣故，它們都不敢來了。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
So Budidai, sings here.
Lots of travelers pass by.
Capre is a wanderer's buddy.
You're a buddy too.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
所以布迪代在這裡唱歌。
很多旅行者經過這裡。
卡普雷是浪姬舞者的夥伴。
你也是我的夥伴。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You interested in that fiend, my friend?
It's just a bully of the forest!
It picks on my animal friends!
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你對那個惡霸感興趣嗎，朋友？
它只是普勒斯特森林裡的惡霸！
它欺負我的動物朋友們！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Sadly, singing is all that Budidai is skilled at.
I can't do anything about the scary gaze and the flailing club.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
可惜，布迪代只會唱歌。
我沒辦法對付那可怕的目光和揮舞的棍棒。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Bongisungisu! I get the chills just by being in the same forest with it...
But Budidai is weak.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
邦吉松吉蘇！光是和它在同一片森林裡，我就感到毛骨悚然...
但布迪代很弱。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You and me, wanderer.
We'll never make it.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你和我，浪姬舞者。
我們永遠也打不過它。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Traveler, my friend!
Bongisungisu ran far far away.
Dogs, cows, horse, goat and rooster will come back to me, won't they?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
旅行者，我的朋友！
邦吉松吉蘇跑得很遠很遠了。
狗、奶牛、馬、山羊和公雞會回到我身邊，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
But Budidai is worried.
The one eyed bully will return eventually.
Will you help me out again?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
但布迪代很擔心。
那個獨眼惡霸遲早會回來的。
你會再幫幫我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You, friend of Budidai
You won't turn you're back on a good Capre?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你，布迪代的朋友。
你不會背棄善良的卡普雷吧？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Astonishing, wanderer!
I could hear the pitiful wails of Bongisungisu all the way from here!
Budidai can sing again for his friends, yes?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
太了不起了，浪姬舞者！
我甚至能聽到邦吉松吉蘇悽慘的哀嚎聲！
布迪代可以再次為朋友們唱歌了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Now, what can Budidai do for the kind wanderer, slayer of the one eyed monster?
Aha! Here's a talisman.
It will be good for you travelers.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
那麼，善良的浪姬舞者，獨眼魔物的殺手，布迪代能為你做些什麼呢？
啊！這裡有一個護身符。
對你們旅行者會有用的。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Kind Capre is a friend of travelers.
I hope to see you again, wanderer.
This is a blessing for friends. Hey hey hey~
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
善良的卡普雷是旅行者的朋友。
希望再次見到你，浪姬舞者。
這是給朋友的祝福。嘿~嘿~嘿~

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Please slay the destructive libertine Bongisungisu.
For me, a Capre to sing again for one's friends.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
請擊敗那個破壞狂邦吉松吉蘇。
為了我，一個能再次為朋友唱歌的卡普雷。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey, kind wanderer.
Bongisungisu, the one eyed debauchee is back!
What do I do? What should I do?
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿，善良的浪姬舞者。
獨眼惡霸邦吉松吉蘇又回來了！
我該怎麼辦？我該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
He gets angry when I sing.
But the horse, cow, goat, dog and boars love it.
It gives Budidai such a hard time.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
我唱歌時它會生氣。
但馬、奶牛、山羊、狗和野豬都喜歡聽。
它讓布迪代很為難。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You interested in that fiend, my friend?
It's just a bully of the forest!
It picks on my animal friends!
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你對那個惡霸感興趣嗎，朋友？
它只是普勒斯特森林裡的惡霸！
它欺負我的動物朋友們！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Sadly, singing is all that Budidai is skilled at.
I can't do anything about the scary gaze and the flailing club.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
可惜，布迪代只會唱歌。
我沒辦法對付那可怕的目光和揮舞的棍棒。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Bongisungisu! I get the chills just by being in the same forest with it...
But Budidai is weak.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
邦吉松吉蘇！光是和它在同一片森林裡，我就感到毛骨悚然...
但布迪代很弱。

scripts.text: Shall I take care of it?
scripts.translation: 我去解決它？

scripts.text: That does give the chills.
scripts.translation: 那確實讓人毛骨悚然。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Don't remind me.
My friends can't come and listen to my songs because of that behemoth.
It is so frustrating.
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
別提醒我了。
因為那個龐然大物，我的朋友們沒法來聽我唱歌。
真是讓人沮喪。

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
You'd teach Bongisungisu a lesson?!
Kind wanderer!!
Kick some libertine butt!!
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
你要給邦吉松吉蘇一個教訓？！
善良的浪姬舞者！！
去揍那個無賴的屁股！！

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Leave me wanderer~
Capre Budidai will sing of wonders~
You best everyone else~
You bring all them beasts~
Just go back to Kafra~
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
去吧，浪姬舞者~
卡普拉布迪代將歌頌奇蹟~
你勝過所有人~
你馴服了所有野獸~
快回卡普拉吧~

scripts.text:
[Budidai]
Hey hey hey~
Blessing of the Kind and Good Capre~
A wanderer's friend the gift of Capre~
Hey hey hey~
scripts.translation:
[布迪代]
嘿 嘿 嘿~
善良卡普拉的祝福~
送給浪姬舞者的禮物~
嘿 嘿 嘿~

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.
scripts.translation: 由於您持有的物品過多，無法繼續。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Oh! Demons are gaining more and more power in this world.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
哦！惡魔在這個世界上的力量越來越強大了。

scripts.text: We need to gather items to fight them off.
scripts.translation: 我們需要收集物品來對抗它們。

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
You don't seem to be strong enough to fight off demons.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
你似乎還不夠強，無法對抗惡魔。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Will you create a Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit with 3 Lesser Agimats and 1,000 Zeny?
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
你要用3個小型護身符和1,000 Zeny製作一個古代聖靈的護身符嗎？

scripts.text: Create.
scripts.translation: 製作

scripts.text: No, thank you.
scripts.translation: 不用了，謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Short on materials.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
材料不足。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Hope you win the fight with the demon.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
希望你在與惡魔的戰鬥中獲勝。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Can't make it now but there is an old way of making it handed down by generations.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
現在無法制作，但有一種代代相傳的古老製作方法。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
You need to call upon the power of Ancient Spirits. But you'll need several important materials first.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
你需要召喚古代聖靈的力量。但首先你需要幾種重要的材料。

scripts.text: What are they?
scripts.translation: 是什麼材料？

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
3 Lesser Agimats to hold the power of Ancient Spirits here and another special material handed down for generations.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
3個小型護身符來容納古代聖靈的力量，以及另一種代代相傳的特殊材料。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
But nobody can get this special item anymore.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
但現在沒人能弄到這種特殊物品了。

scripts.text: Something money cannot buy?
scripts.translation: 是金錢買不到的東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
No, no... It's this round little thing, you see?
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
不，不... 你看，就是這種圓圓的小東西。

scripts.text: Are you talking about Zeny?
scripts.translation: 你說的是Zeny嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Looks similar to the special items handed down from generations.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
看起來很像那種代代相傳的特殊物品。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
As long as we have enough of that, we could make the Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit to fight against the demons.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
只要我們有足夠的材料，就能製作古代聖靈的護身符來對抗惡魔。

scripts.text: Sounds good.
scripts.translation: 聽起來不錯。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
In case you are too weary to take on the demons...
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
如果你太累了，不想親自去對付惡魔的話...

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Come by with 3 Lesser Agimats and 1,000 of those so-called Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
請帶著3個小型護身符和1000個所謂的Zeny過來。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
I will make a Greater Agimat of Ancient Spirit that will increase your attacks against demons by 10% for 20 min.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
我會製作一個古代聖靈的護身符，它能讓你在20分鐘內對惡魔的攻擊力提升10%。

scripts.text:
[Old Man in Dilemma]
Hope you win the fight with the demon.
scripts.translation:
[為難的老人]
希望你在與惡魔的戰鬥中獲勝。

scripts.text: Cannot proceed because you have too many items in your possession.
scripts.translation: 由於您持有的物品過多，無法繼續。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
I spent 90% of my life studying Tikbalang.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
我花了90%的人生在研究邪魔馬上。

scripts.text: But you look young?
scripts.translation: 但你看起來很年輕？

scripts.text: What is Tikbalang?
scripts.translation: 什麼是邪魔馬？

scripts.text: Teach me how to catch a Tikbalang.
scripts.translation: 教我如何捕捉邪魔馬。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
What! I might be imagining things.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
什麼！我可能是在做夢。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
I look younger than I am because of my baby face. Ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
我看起來比實際年齡年輕是因為我有娃娃臉。哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Trust!! They say faith will bring you luck.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
信任！據說信任會帶來好運。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha... You ask the right question.
I'm a specialist in that field. Ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哈哈...你問對了問題。
我是這個領域的專家。儘管問吧。

scripts.text: Why won't you answer me?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼不回答我？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Have you... ever been fooled by anyone around you? Why can't you believe someone's word for it? Really, ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
你...曾經被周圍的人欺騙過嗎？為什麼你不能相信別人的話呢？真的，儘管問吧。

scripts.text: I don't have any questions.
scripts.translation: 我沒有問題。

scripts.text: Characteristics?
scripts.translation: 特徵？

scripts.text: Features?
scripts.translation: 特點？

scripts.text: Rumors?
scripts.translation: 傳聞？

scripts.text: Habitat?
scripts.translation: 棲息地？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
I think this is enough explanation for now. You wouldn't understand other highly sophisticated topics with specific terminology and all anyway.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
我覺得這就解釋得夠多了。反正那些涉及專業術語的高深話題，你也是聽不懂的。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Oh! Do you have any other questions?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哦！你還有其他問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
What do you think? Impressed at how much I know? Come by anytime when you have any more questions.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
你覺得怎麼樣？是不是被我淵博的知識折服了？以後有任何問題，隨時歡迎來找我。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Tikbalangs have a way to confuse travelers when they meet them by making them turn in circles regardless of wherever and how far they travel.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
邪魔馬有一種讓旅行者迷路的方法。當它們遇到旅行者時，會讓對方無論走多遠、朝哪個方向走，最後都只是在原地打轉。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
They are mischievous creatures.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
它們是喜歡惡作劇的生物。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
But of course there is a way to stop their pranks. You know about the Inside-out Shirt? You can either wear your top inside-out.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
不過當然，也有辦法阻止它們的惡作劇。你知道反穿的襯衫嗎？你可以把上衣反著穿。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Or go on your way quietly without disrupting the Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
或者，在不打擾邪魔馬的情況下，安靜地通過。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha ha ha~ But everyone knows adventurers are never quiet while they travel, right?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哈哈哈哈~ 不過大家都知道，冒險者在旅行時從來都不會安靜，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Never...
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
從來不會...

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
They say Tikbalangs have several distinctions.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
據說邪魔馬有幾個顯著的特徵。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
First, they are very tall ^AAAAAA(tsk... wish I were tall)^000000 and have skinny, imbalanced legs and arms. Looks almost like a human but their knees are higher than their upper body when they sit down.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
首先，它們非常高^AAAAAA（嘖...真希望我也這麼高）^000000，四肢細長且比例失調。看起來很像人類，但坐下時膝蓋會高於上半身。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Second, is the standard characteristics acknowledged by the association. They have heads and feet like a horse.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
其次，是協會公認的標準特徵。它們擁有馬一樣的頭和腳。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
So with all these appearance traits, Tikbalang is sometimes called the creature from hell.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
綜合這些外貌特徵，邪魔馬有時也被稱為來自地獄的生物。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
There are several fun rumors about Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
關於邪魔馬，還有幾個有趣的傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
One of them is about Tikbalangs being the guardians of some kingdom that worships nature.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
其中一個傳聞是，邪魔馬是某個崇拜自然的王國的守護者。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
So the Tikbalangs will trick travelers who come with bad intentions to the kingdom by making them travel in circles.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
所以，邪魔馬會戲弄那些懷著惡意來到王國的旅行者，讓他們在原地打轉。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Another rumor is that people around here say that 'if it rains on a clear day, then it must be Tikbalang's wedding day'.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
另一個傳聞是，這裡的人常說：'如果大晴天突然下雨，那一定是邪魔馬在舉行婚禮'。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
The association speculates that sayings like 'it rains on Bathory's wedding day' or 'it rains on Moonlight Flower's wedding day' might have derived from the Tikbalang's saying.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
協會推測，像'巴托里結婚那天會下雨'或'月夜貓結婚那天會下雨'這樣的說法，可能都源自關於邪魔馬的這句諺語。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Lastly, ancient fairy tales say that Tikbalangs can transform into human form or even make themselves transparen't but nobody has verified this yet.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
最後，古老的神話傳說邪魔馬可以變成人形，甚至能讓自己變得透明，但至今還沒有人證實過這一點。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Tikbalangs usually live in dark, busy places where there aren't many people around.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
邪魔馬通常棲息在陰暗、繁忙且人煙稀少的地方。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Hmm... For example, they are known to live beneath bridges, in banana and bamboo forests and beneath large trees.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
嗯... 比如，它們據說住在橋下、香蕉林和竹林裡，或者大樹底下。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
And this is just my opinion but wouldn't you agree that they are living in dark places because it is easier to play pranks on people?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
這只是我個人的看法，但你不覺得它們住在陰暗的地方，是因為那樣更容易捉弄人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha ha. Do you now know how great I am?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哈哈哈。現在你知道我有多厲害了吧？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Oh! Isn't this material to make 'Tikbalang Belt' used to tame Tikbalangs?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哦！這不是用來馴服邪魔馬的“邪魔馬腰帶”的材料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is used to capture Tikbalangs without the hassle. But that doesn't mean it's 100% successful. Interested? Do you want me to make one for you?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
“^F80835邪魔馬腰帶^000000”可以用來輕鬆捕捉邪魔馬，但這並不意味著成功率是100%。有興趣嗎？要我幫你做一個嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, I'm interested.
scripts.translation: 是的，我有興趣

scripts.text: No, I can capture one myself.
scripts.translation: 不，我可以自己捕捉

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Yiiiiiiiiiiii! Yap!
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
耶耶耶耶耶耶！好耶！

scripts.text: Huh?
scripts.translation: 咦？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
The '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' is already created.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
“^F80835邪魔馬腰帶^000000”已經制作好了。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
You? Ha... You can try if you want to.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
你？哈... 如果你想試試的話，儘管試吧。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
There is the easy way and the hard way to capture Tikbalangs. Which one do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
捕捉邪魔馬有簡單的方法，也有困難的方法。你更喜歡哪一種？

scripts.text: Easy way.
scripts.translation: 簡單的方法

scripts.text: Hard way.
scripts.translation: 困難的方法

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha. I've come up with the easy way myself.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哈哈。簡單的方法可是我自己想出來的。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Bring me 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats to make a '^F80835Tikbalang Belt^000000' to help you easily capture Tikbalangs.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
給我3個邪魔馬的厚脊椎骨和5個小型護身符，我來製作一條“^F80835邪魔馬腰帶^000000”，幫你輕鬆捕捉邪魔馬。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Ha ha ha ha ha!
I will say it again.
It's 3 Tikbalang's Thick Spines and 5 Lesser Agimats. Understood?
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！
我再重複一遍。
是3個邪魔馬的厚脊椎骨和5個小型護身符。聽明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
It's easy for me but I don't know about you.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
對我來說這很簡單，但不知道對你來說如何。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Tikbalangs have a sharp, pointy mane behind their neck.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
邪魔馬的脖子後面有一撮尖銳的鬃毛。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Of course! There are several of them but you must get the three thickest ones.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
當然！那裡有好幾根，但你必須拿到最粗的三根。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
These three manes are the weak point. You can tame a Tikbalang by pulling the manes out.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
這三根鬃毛是它的弱點。你可以把鬃毛拔出來，從而馴服邪魔馬。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Now let me explain how to pull these manes out.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
現在讓我來解釋一下如何拔出這些鬃毛。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
You must fly like a butterfly and land like a bee on the back of a Tikbalang.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
你必須像蝴蝶一樣飛舞，像蜜蜂一樣落在邪魔馬的背上。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Of course! The Tikbalang will get mad and try to shake you off with all its might.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
當然！邪魔馬會生氣，並竭盡全力試圖把你甩下去。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
All you have to do is hold on until the Tikbalang gets exhausted.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
你只需要堅持住，直到邪魔馬精疲力竭。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Then again, itll take 4 days and 3 nights for Tikbalangs to get tired since they are strong creatures. But let's not focus on too much details.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
不過話說回來，因為邪魔馬是強大的生物，它們需要4天3夜才會感到疲憊。但我們不必糾結於這些細節。

scripts.text:
[Tikbalang Expert]
Which means!! The Tikbalang is already tamed.
scripts.translation:
[提克巴朗專家]
也就是說！！邪魔馬已經被馴服了。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
I will upgrade your armor if you bring one that holds enormous power.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
如果你帶來蘊含巨大力量的裝備，我會為你升級它。

scripts.text: What kind of equipment do upgrade?
scripts.translation: 升級什麼型別的裝備？

scripts.text: What are the required materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什麼材料？

scripts.text: What will it become after an upgrade?
scripts.translation: 升級後會變成什麼？

scripts.text: Please upgrade this.
scripts.translation: 請升級這個。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Your questions are too simple, but!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
你的問題太簡單了，但是！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Are also important.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
這些也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^7B4772Bakonawa Scale Armor^000000 made from the scales of the Bakonawa monster known to swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
^7B4772食月者鱗甲^000000，由以吞食月亮聞名的魔物巴庫暴龍的鱗片製成。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Light but sturdy ^7B4772Kalasag^000000 made from rattan that grows wild around Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
^7B4772卡拉沙矩盾^000000，由生長在馬來港周圍的野生藤條製成，輕便且堅固。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^7B4772Buwaya Sack Cloth^000000 made from the sack of the man-eating alligator Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
^7B4772寶箱巨鱷披肩^000000，由食人魔物寶箱巨鱷的囊袋製成。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^7B4772Bangungot Boots of Nightmare^000000 imbued with the hatred and vengeance of the monster Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
^7B4772噩夢的般滾勾特長靴^000000，蘊含了魔物般滾勾特的仇恨與復仇之力。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
As just mentioned.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
正如剛才所說。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
I will make powerful armor out of ONLY the strongest armor dropped from fearful monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
我只用從可怕魔物身上掉落的、最強力的裝備來製作強力護甲。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Learned well.
Seems you learned that there is no such thing as free in life.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
學得不錯。
看來你已經明白了，這世上沒有免費的午餐。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
First thing to remember is that the object to upgrade must be strong itself. At least strong enough to endure ^FF0000+9 Refinement^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
首先要記住的是，要升級的物品本身必須足夠堅固。至少得能承受^FF0000+9精煉^000000。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Next is true strength that only comes out of power obtained naturally. I need ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection from evil while Im refining.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
其次是隻有從自然力量中獲得的真正強度。我需要^FF000020個古代的咒符^000000，以便在精煉時抵禦邪惡。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
When a ^FF0000+9 Refined Strong armor^000000 is combined with ^FF000020 Ancient Grudges^000000 for protection!!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
當^FF0000+9精煉的強力護甲^000000與^FF000020個古代的咒符^000000結合以提供保護時！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
You get a completely new and improved armor from old scraps.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
你就能從舊廢料中獲得一件全新且升級的護甲。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Always look forward to this.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
我總是期待這一刻。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Listen, because this is a very important question.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
聽好了，因為這是一個非常重要的問題。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
It won't matter if I say it more than a 100 times that upgraded armor is powerful.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
無論我說多少遍，升級後的護甲都很強大，這並不重要。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Unless the one that holds it doesn't believe it is! Ask about what has changed and decide for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
除非持有它的人不相信這一點！問問自己有什麼改變，然後自己做出決定！

scripts.text: There is no more.
scripts.translation: 沒有了

scripts.text: Bakonawa Scale Armor
scripts.translation: 食月者鱗甲

scripts.text: Kalasag
scripts.translation: 卡拉沙矩盾

scripts.text: Buwaya Sack Cloth
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷披肩

scripts.text: Bangungot Boots of Nightmare
scripts.translation: 噩夢的般滾勾特長靴

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Looks like you ran out of questions.
Don't forget. You'll have to give up something to gain something.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
看來你的問題問完了。
別忘了。要想得到某些東西，就必須放棄某些東西。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The Bakonawa Scale Armor adds +1 to all stats for all jobs which is overall great armor for everyone.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
食月者鱗甲為所有職業的所有屬性提供+1加成，是一件對所有人都很棒的護甲。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But I'm sure the inner you thinks this isn't enough.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
但我相信，你內心深處覺得這還不夠。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
That is why +2 can be added to all stats and an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
因此，如果進行升級，所有屬性可以額外增加+2，並且可以插入一張卡片。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Kalasag is a good shield to reduce damage from boss monsters by 1% per 3 refinements.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
卡拉沙矩盾是一件不錯的盾牌，每精煉3次，可以減少來自Boss魔物的1%傷害。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But not enough. Can't believe that a shield doesnt have a place to equip a card.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
但這還不夠。真不敢相信盾牌竟然沒有地方可以裝備卡片。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
That is why I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
因此，如果進行升級，我可以為你的裝備額外增加一個卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The Buwaya Sack Cloth offers healing capacity and healing item effect increase by 1% per 3 refinements. Not to mention it reduces 10% damage from Water, Earth, Fire, and Wind elemental monsters.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
寶箱巨鱷披肩每精煉3次，治療效果和治療物品效果增加1%。此外，它還能減少來自水、地、火、風屬性魔物10%的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But not enough. Can't believe that these clothes don't come with a place to equip a card. Everyone knows that clothes should have Raydric on them!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
但這還不夠。真不敢相信衣服竟然沒有地方可以裝備卡片。大家都知道，衣服上應該插著幽靈劍士卡片！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Don't worry! I can add an extra slot for a card to your socket if upgraded.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
別擔心！如果進行升級，我可以為你的裝備額外增加一個卡片插槽。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The Bangungot Boots of Nightmare increases +1 MDEF per 1 refinement and speed increases starting at 14 refinement and above.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
噩夢的般滾勾特長靴每精煉1次，魔法防禦力增加+1，並且從精煉+14開始增加移動速度。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
The speed increase effect from shoes like Moonlight Flower Shoes and Sleipnir items are out of reach for ordinary people.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
像月夜貓之靴或史雷普尼爾之靴那樣的加速效果，對普通人來說遙不可及。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
But of course, +14 refinement isn't easy but there is an easy way to get it.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
當然，精煉+14並不容易，但有一個簡單的方法可以實現。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
By upgrading your shoes, you can get speed increase starting from +12 refinement!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
通過升級你的鞋子，你從精煉+12開始就能獲得加速效果！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
And it doesn't end there!!
I will also put in an extra slot in your socket to add a card.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
而且不止於此！！
我還會在你的裝備上額外增加一個插槽來插入卡片。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
However, you'll have to give up something to gain something.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
不過，想要得到某些東西，就必須放棄某些東西。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
^0000FF同時裝備卡拉沙矩盾、寶箱巨鱷披肩、食月者鱗甲和噩夢的般滾勾特長靴，將會失去^FF0000套裝效果^0000FF。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Think it through. Next question?
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
好好考慮一下。還有下一個問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha! Good!
You've brought the materials, right?
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
哈哈哈哈哈哈！很好！
你帶來材料了嗎？

scripts.text: Oh... sorry...
Preparations are complete!!
scripts.translation: 準備完畢！！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Oh no!!
I will need an light but sturdy armor with an refinement of +9 or greater and 20 Ancient Grudges!!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
糟糕！！
我需要一件精煉+9或更高、輕便且堅固的護甲，以及20個古代的咒符！！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
You said all preparations are done and you give me this?! I need at least 20 Ancient Grudges to refine your item.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
你說準備都做好了，卻給我這個？！我至少需要20個古代的咒符來精煉你的物品。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
So what armor will it be?
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
那麼，你要升級的是哪件護甲？

scripts.text: Bakonawa Scale Armor
scripts.translation: 食月者鱗甲

scripts.text: Kalasag
scripts.translation: 卡拉沙矩盾

scripts.text: Buwaya Sack Cloth
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷披肩

scripts.text: Bangungot Boots of Nightmare
scripts.translation: 噩夢的般滾勾特長靴

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
You should wear the equipment to upgrade and not come without it on you.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
你應該穿著要升級的裝備過來，而不是空手來。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
What is this! You said you wanted to upgrade {0} but why are you giving me this? You should be wearing {1}.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
這是怎麼回事！你說你想升級{0}，但為什麼給我這個？你應該穿著{1}。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
No, the sturdiness of this item has not been tested yet. It'll have to be at least +9 refined for me to say, 'Oh this is pretty sturdy armor.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
不，這件裝備的堅固程度還沒有經過測試。至少需要精煉到+9，我才能說“哦，這件護甲相當堅固”。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Looks like you did your homework! Don't see a flaw! Then I have one question to ask before I start refinement.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
看來你做了功課！我看不到任何瑕疵！那麼，在我開始精煉之前，我有一個問題要問你。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
^0000FFOnce your item is refined, the refinement level will be ^FF00000^0000FF and the item will be upgraded.^000000 You get this part?
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
^0000FF一旦你的裝備精煉完成，精煉等級將變為 ^FF00000^0000FF，並且裝備會得到升級。^000000 你明白這一點嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
什麼？你不知道這個？那麼，請仔細閱讀我的說明，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Good. Next question. Once refinement is done,
^0000FFEquipping the Kalasag, Buwaya Sack Cloth, Bakonawa Scale Armor, and Bangungot Boots of Nightmare all at once will lose the ^FF0000Set Effects^0000FF.^000000
Do you understand this point?
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
很好。下一個問題。精煉完成後，
^0000FF同時裝備卡拉沙矩盾、寶箱巨鱷披肩、食月者鱗甲和噩夢的般滾勾特長靴將會失去 ^FF0000套裝效果^0000FF。^000000
你理解這一點嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
What? You didn't know this? Then, read through my instructions and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
什麼？你不知道這個？那麼，請仔細閱讀我的說明，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Awesome! Then let's start refining {0}.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
太棒了！那麼讓我們開始精煉{0}吧。

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Pow!! Wow!! Flip... flop!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
砰！！哇！！翻...翻！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
BAM!!
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
轟！！

scripts.text:
[Bayani]
Ha ha. Perfect.
Congratulations. Your armor is better than ever.
scripts.translation:
[巴亞尼]
哈哈。完美。
恭喜。你的護甲比以往任何時候都要好。

scripts.text: - From the wary looks on the guard's face, it is obvious he is at alert at the sight of you. He won't intimidate you but seems he won't even deal with you either. -
scripts.translation: - 從衛兵警惕的眼神中可以看出，他看到你時處於警戒狀態。他不會抄襲你，但似乎也不打算理會你。 -

scripts.text: - Would there be anyone to talk to in the village? -
scripts.translation: - 村莊裡會有人願意和我說話嗎？ -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
There is a small area called ^3131FFBaryo Mahiwaga^000000 outside of Port Malaya.
The place is closer to mother nature than what we have here.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
在馬來港外面有一個叫 ^3131FFBaryo Mahiwaga^000000 的小區域。
那裡的地方比我們這裡更接近大自然。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
On the other hand, the area is full of fierce monsters. Take care of yourself while you're traveling there.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
另一方面，那個區域充滿了兇猛的魔物。你在那裡旅行時要小心。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
There are more people leaving the village secretly these days. Are you also heading for the woods to look for the mysterious treasure?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
最近有更多村民秘密離開村莊。你也是要去樹林裡尋找神秘的寶物嗎？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I take that back. On second thought, I don't think a weakling like you would even dare to go there.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我收回剛才的話。仔細想想，我覺得像你這樣的弱者甚至不敢去那裡。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
You'd better hold tight to your mommy's hand if you want to go outside of Port Malaya or else the monsters will eat you alive. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
如果你想離開馬來港，最好緊緊抓住你母親的手，否則魔物會把你活活吃掉。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Is that why there are more outsiders here these days? Now don't be sneaky and a know-it-all. How would you know if I'd offered to take you around?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
這就是為什麼最近這裡的外來者變多了嗎？別鬼鬼祟祟的，也別裝懂。你怎麼知道我會提議帶你四處看看呢？

scripts.text: Treasure?
scripts.translation: 寶物？

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Are you ignoring me? Bah.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你在無視我嗎？哼。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Oh, so you aren't here to look for treasure?
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
哦，所以你不是來找寶物的？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
I hear people are talking about a mysterious treasure hidden deep in the woods.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
我聽說有人在議論，說森林深處藏著一筆神秘的寶物。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Do you see that group of people over there? They always gather and talk about it every day.
Try talking to them if you are interested, too.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
你看到那邊那群人了嗎？他們每天都聚在一起談論這件事。
如果你也感興趣，不妨去跟他們聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
So the talk about treasure was just a rumor? I'm not asking because I want to be rich overnight. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
原來關於寶物的傳聞只是謠言啊？我可不是想一夜暴富才問的。哈哈。

scripts.text: - Look at you warily while whispering to each other. -
scripts.translation: - 警惕地看著你，並互相低聲交談。 -

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
No, I heard they got lost in the woods.
Who would hide such a treasure from a small village like ours?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
不，我聽說他們是在森林裡迷路了。
誰會在這種小村莊附近藏這麼貴重的寶物呢？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Could it been a monster? My grandma said there is a dragon with a huge head living deep inside the woods.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
難道是魔物？我老奶奶說，森林深處住著一隻頭特別大的龍。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
No. Listen to me.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
不。聽我說。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
You all know ^3131FFTotoy^000000? The kid living at the ^3131FFInn^000000.
Well, did you know Totoy came back from the woods recently?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
你們都知道^3131FF托托伊^000000吧？就是住在^3131FF旅店^000000裡的那個小孩。
你們知道嗎，托托伊最近剛從森林裡回來？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Really??? He came back alive?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
真的？？？他活著回來了？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Yeah. But the strange part is that the troublemaker ^3131FFTotoy^000000 now quietly stays home and never comes out.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
是啊。但奇怪的是，那個搗蛋鬼^3131FF托托伊^000000現在總是安安靜靜地待在家裡，再也不出來了。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Why?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
為什麼？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Don't you get it? Totoy must have found the treasure.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
你們沒看出來嗎？托托伊肯定是找到了寶物。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
What!!!! Then ^3131FFTotoy^000000 is rich now?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
什麼！！那^3131FF托托伊^000000現在變富了？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
I don't think so.
I saw ^3131FFTotoy^000000 come back home, but Totoy wasn't carrying anything.
But then, I must have missed it because I ran back home right away.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
我不這麼認為。
我看到^3131FF托托伊^000000回家時，他手裡什麼都沒拿。
不過，也許是我沒注意到，因為我當時急著跑回家了。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Then what is ^3131FFTotoy^000000 doing at home?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
那^3131FF托托伊^000000在家幹什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
I think Totoy is making a plan to bring the treasure back without us knowing it.
To have the whole treasure for himself, that greedy kid.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
我覺得托托伊是在策劃怎麼把寶物運回來，又不讓我們知道。
他想獨吞整筆寶物，那個貪婪的小孩。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Is that true?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
The treasure would be in better hands with me ~
I would clean it every day so it shined and would use it as a beautiful ornament. Ah~~~
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
寶物交給我保管更好吧～
我會每天把它擦得閃閃發光，把它當作漂亮的裝飾品。啊～～～

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Then how about we talk to ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to spill the beans on where the treasure is?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
那我們要不要去問問^3131FF托托伊^000000，讓他說出寶物的位置？

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Wow. That is an awesome idea. No wonder you're the leader!
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
哇。真是個好主意。難怪你是首領！

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
But will ^3131FFTotoy^000000 give up the information easily?
Because Totoy was sneaky enough to think of getting away with taking the whole treasure.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
但是^3131FF托托伊^000000會輕易交出情報嗎？
畢竟他狡猾到能想到獨吞整筆寶物。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Then we should convince ^3131FFTotoy^000000 to tell us where the treasure is instead of looking for it ourselves.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
那我們還是去說服^3131FF托托伊^000000，讓他告訴我們寶物的位置，而不是自己去找吧。

scripts.text:
[Port Malaya Villager]
Ah~~~ it is so hard to get something pretty these days ~~~!!!!
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅港村民]
啊～～～現在想弄到漂亮的東西真難～～～！！！！

scripts.text: - Better pay a visit to this Totoy to get more information about the treasure. -
scripts.translation: - 最好去拜訪一下托托伊，獲取更多關於寶物的情報。 -

scripts.text: - People are talking with serious faces. -
scripts.translation: - 人們正一臉嚴肅地交談著。 -

scripts.text: - See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 看到一個人眼神呆滯，渾身發抖。 -

scripts.text: - See someone shaky with dopey eyes. -
scripts.translation: - 看到一個人眼神呆滯，渾身發抖。 -

scripts.text: Tap him on the shoulder.
scripts.translation: 拍他的肩膀

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Wah! No! Go away! Leave me alone!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
哇！不！走開！別管我！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, are you alright?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Huh... you're a person? Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
嗯...你是個人類？你是誰？

scripts.text: - He looks you straight in the face but doesn't seem to recognize you. -
scripts.translation: - 他直直地看著你的臉，但似乎並不認識你。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Who's there?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
誰在那兒？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am {1}. You are Totoy, right? People say you've found a treasure. Is it true?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是{1}。你是托托伊，對吧？聽說你發現了一筆寶物，是真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
What treasure?
I can't see. I'm blinded. Please help me. I'm tired and frustrated.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
什麼寶物？
我看不見。我瞎了。請幫幫我。我很累，也很沮喪。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
發生什麼事了？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you take it out for me?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
沒法聊太久。我得先治治我的眼睛。
抽屜裡應該還有^3131FF綠色藥水^000000。你能幫我拿出來嗎？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Can't talk long. I need to heal my eyes first.
There should be some ^3131FFGreen Potion^000000 left inside the drawer. Will you get it for me?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
沒法聊太久。我得先治治我的眼睛。
抽屜裡應該還有^3131FF綠色藥水^000000。你能幫我拿一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Hello? Hey, are you still there? What happened to the Green Potion? Jeez, this is driving me crazy.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
喂？嘿，你還在嗎？綠色藥水怎麼樣了？天哪，這快把我逼瘋了。

scripts.text: Hand over the Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 交出綠色藥水

scripts.text: Do not hand over the potion.
scripts.translation: 不交出藥水

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Did you really leave? Hey! Darn!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
你真的走了嗎？嘿！該死！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Gulp, gulp...
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
咕嘟，咕嘟...

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I can see!! My eyes work!!!
Yay! I feel better now!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我看見了！我的眼睛好了！
耶！我感覺好多了！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Wow! You look better than you sounded. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
哇！你看起來比聽起來好多了。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
But what did you say? Something about a treasure?
Did you say I found a treasure?
What is that about?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
不過你剛才說什麼來著？好像提到了寶物？
你說我找到了寶物？
那是怎麼回事？

scripts.text: Tell him what the people are talking about.
scripts.translation: 告訴他人們在議論什麼

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
WHAT?
Puhaha! Totoy is rich! Became rich overnight! Chief Ed!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
什麼？
噗哈哈！托托伊發財了！一夜暴富！首領艾德！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Sorry but I went to the woods to collect bugs. Wish I saw a treasure while I was at it. Hmph!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
抱歉，我去樹林裡抓蟲子了。要是順便能看到寶物就好了。哼！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I did go deep in the woods because I wasn't getting anywhere with collecting bugs. But who would have thought I'd get into this mess?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我確實深入了樹林，因為抓蟲子沒什麼進展。但誰能想到我會陷入這種麻煩呢？

scripts.text: What Totoy saw
scripts.translation: 托托伊看到了什麼

scripts.text: About bugs
scripts.translation: 關於蟲子

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I only wanted to show people my collection of cute bugs. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我只是想給大家看看我收集的可愛蟲子。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Dropping ice or bugs down peoples clothes is just like a daily greeting, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
把冰塊或蟲子塞進別人衣服裡，就像日常問候一樣，不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I love to see people run around the village like they are in a marathon. He he.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我喜歡看人們在村子裡跑來跑去，就像在跑馬拉松一樣。嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I thought people wouldn't run away because of an ordinary bug so I went in the woods with Ed.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我以為人們不會因為一隻普通的蟲子就逃跑，所以我和艾德一起去了樹林。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ah, Ed is my cute puppy. He's very nice and cuddly. My best friend in the whole wide world.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
啊，艾德是我可愛的小狗。它非常溫順可愛。是我在這個世界上最要好的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed usually barks a lot but I should have looked around when he barked and pulled on my sleeves.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德平時總是叫個不停，但我本該在它叫喚並拉扯我袖子的時候四處看看的。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
- Totoy bends over and whispers to you as if walls have ears. -
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
- 托托伊彎下腰，彷彿牆壁有耳朵一樣，對你低聲耳語。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
There was a monster with a mouth the size of a house right behind me.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我身後有一隻嘴巴像房子那麼大的魔物。

scripts.text: A monster?!
scripts.translation: 魔物？！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Shssh! Be quiet. I've never seen a mouth that big before. It was full of a river of saliva flowing out of spiky teeth. Just the thought of it makes me want to hide.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
噓！小聲點。我從沒見過那麼大的嘴巴。裡面全是尖牙，還流著像河流一樣的口水。光是想想我就想躲起來。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
The scariest part is that the monster has two heads. You won't believe it till you see it.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
最可怕的是，那隻魔物有兩個頭。你不親眼看到絕對不敢相信。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed bit the monsters leg with all his might to let me get away. But I don't know what happened to him afterwards. Sniff~
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德拼盡全力咬住魔物的腿，好讓我逃掉。但我不知道它後來怎麼樣了。吸溜~

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
That's when I hurt my eye. To tell you the truth I don't even remember how I came back.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
就在那時，我的眼睛受傷了。說實話，我甚至不記得自己是怎麼回來的。

scripts.text: About the monster
scripts.translation: 關於那隻魔物

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Don't know. It was the first time I saw a monster like that. Who could live to tell the story?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
不知道。那是我第一次見到那種魔物。誰能活著回來講述這段經歷呢？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Wait, maybe the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000 might know about the monster. They say he fought with all sorts of monsters.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
等等，也許^FF0000狩獵大師^000000會知道那隻魔物。據說他和各種各樣的魔物都交過手。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I need some time alone. I need to make a tombstone for Ed. If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我需要一個人靜靜。我要給艾德立塊墓碑。如果你想見^FF0000狩獵大師^000000，他在武器店附近。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
And tell everyone else to stop spreading rumors about treasure. They don't know what I went through. Sniff! I'm going to put Ancient Worms in everyones clothes!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
還有，告訴其他人別再散佈關於寶物的謠言了。他們根本不知道我經歷了什麼。吸溜！我要把狂暴蜈蚣塞進每個人的衣服裡！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
I have to make a grave for Ed. My loyal friend, Ed...
If you want to meet the ^FF0000Master of Hunting^000000, you'll find him near the Weapon Store.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我得給艾德挖個墓。我忠誠的朋友，艾德...
如果你想見^FF0000狩獵大師^000000，他在武器店附近。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed!! Eeeeeddddddd!!!
Can't believe you gave your life to save me. Wail!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德！！艾德！！！！！！
真不敢相信你為了救我獻出了生命。哇哇哇！！

scripts.text: - Totoy can't be lying when he's crying his heart out like this. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊哭得如此傷心，他不可能在說謊。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Where I saw the monster?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
我見到那隻魔物的地方？

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Um... Hmm...
I was so busy running away...
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
嗯... 唔...
我當時只顧著逃命了...

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
It was really deep in the woods. Probably even past Baryo Mahiwaga.
I think I heard the sound of ^3131FFFlowing Water^000000. A large whooshing sound. This is all I remember.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
那是在很深的樹林裡。可能甚至超過了巴里奧·馬希瓦加。
我記得聽到了^3131FF流水^000000的聲音。很大的嘩嘩聲。我只記得這些。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
可憐的艾德。我想念艾德。哇哇哇哇！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Poor Ed. I miss Ed. Wail!!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
可憐的艾德。我想念艾德。哇哇哇哇！！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed!!
Ed!!! You're alive!!!
You've come back!!! I'm so happy!!!!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德！！
艾德！！！你活著！！！
你回來了！！！我太高興了！！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Did you bring Ed back?
Thank you so much!
You didn't see the monster, did you?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
是你把艾德帶回來的嗎？
太感謝你了！
你沒看到那隻魔物，對吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The monster is called Buwaya. I told the Guard about the monster. You better not go near the place again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那隻魔物叫寶箱巨鱷。我已經告訴衛兵關於那隻魔物的事了。你最好別再靠近那個地方了。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Okay!
He he. Ed, the woods are too dangerous so we can't go there for bugs anymore.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
好的！
呵呵。艾德，森林太危險了，我們不能再去找蟲子了。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Whimper...

[Totoy]
But I'm sure we can find a way to keep our reputation with other creepy stuff!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
但我相信我們一定能找到其他可怕的東西來維持我們的名聲！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Anyway, thanks for bringing my best friend back.
I don't have much but would like to thank you. Wait, let me see what's inside my drawer. He he-
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
總之，謝謝你把我最好的朋友帶回來。
我沒什麼東西，但還是想感謝一下你。等等，讓我看看抽屜裡有什麼。呵呵-

scripts.text:
- Wait!! -
- You have too many items on you. -
- Cannot receive the item. -
- Clean up your items -
- And please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你身上的物品太多了。 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請清理你的物品 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text: - Totoy goes through the drawer, turning it upside down. Making a mess of the room. -
scripts.translation: - 托托伊翻遍了抽屜，把抽屜倒過來。把房間弄得一團糟。 -

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Found it!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
找到了！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Here. My mom gave it to me but I don't know how to use it... He he.
I hope you can use it.
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
給你。這是我媽媽給我的，但我不知道怎麼用... 呵呵。
希望你能用上它。

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Visit me when you get bored!
Just don't ask about the treasure again~!
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
無聊的時候來找我玩吧！
只是別再問關於寶藏的事了~！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Woof woof woof!!!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪汪！！！！

scripts.text:
[Totoy]
Ed went out to play so I'm alone.
Would there be something awesome to surprise people with?
scripts.translation:
[托托伊]
艾德出去玩了，所以只有我一個人在家。
有沒有什麼厲害的東西可以讓人大吃一驚呢？

scripts.text: - You look for the Green Potion in Totoys drawer. -
scripts.translation: - 你在托托伊的抽屜裡尋找綠色藥水。 -

scripts.text: - Rummaging, fumbling. -
scripts.translation: - 翻找，摸索。 -

scripts.text:
- Rummaging, fumbling. -
- Rummaging, fumbling. -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找，摸索。 -
- 翻找，摸索。 -

scripts.text: - Clunk, clank, crunch. -
scripts.translation: - 哐當，哐當，咔嚓。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? I only see an empty potion bottle.
Does this mean I have to get the potion myself? That Totoy is really a troublemaker.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什麼？我只看到一個空藥瓶。
這意味著我得自己去拿藥水嗎？那個托托伊真是個麻煩製造者。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh! Ho! Ho!
I am the Master of Hunting! I'm not afraid of anything with just one exception! I'm afraid of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
哦！呵！呵！
我是狩獵大師！除了一個例外，我什麼都不怕！我害怕外人...

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Yo! Ho! Ho!
I went all the way to Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to defeat the Angry Minorous.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
喲！呵！呵！
我一路來到盧恩·米德加茲王國，擊敗了憤怒的米洛斯。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
And I succeeded in killing Muka, the one with the voice of a demon that disturbs the peace of the world.
Wow! He was really tough. I'm starting to sweat just thinking of him.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
我成功殺死了摩卡，那個用惡魔的聲音擾亂世界和平的傢伙。
哇！他真的很強。光是想想我就開始出汗了。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Yo! You look like you have a few battle stories yourself. Have you ever seen a Minorous? Ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
喲！你看起來也有幾段戰鬥故事。你見過米洛斯嗎？哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
So you came here to learn all about my excellent hunting skills? Or to ask me to publish an essay on Master of Hunting? Ho!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
所以你是來這裡想學習我高超的狩獵技巧？還是想讓我發表一篇關於狩獵大師的文章？呵！

scripts.text: About Totoys monster
scripts.translation: 關於托托伊的魔物

scripts.text: Interrupt.
scripts.translation: 打斷

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh? Hey! Where are you going?!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
哦？嘿！你要去哪裡？！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
You say someone saw the monster?
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
你說有人看到了那隻魔物？

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
There are many monsters in and out of Port Malaya. What is so special about this one?
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
馬來港內外有很多魔物。這隻有什麼特別的嗎？

scripts.text: About a monster with two heads
scripts.translation: 關於一隻雙頭魔物

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ho! A monster with two heads, you say? Are you kidding? Where on earth is there a monster with two heads?!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
呵！雙頭魔物？你在開玩笑吧？世界上哪裡會有雙頭魔物？！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
The kid must have been scared by a Condor or something.
There's a saying that someone surprised to see a Permeter, will also be surprised to see a peach tree. Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
那小孩肯定是被禿鷹之類的嚇到了。
俗話說，看到果樹龜會驚訝的人，看到桃樹也會驚訝。哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
You shouldn't lie to an adult. I understand you want the Master of Huntings attention. Ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
你不該對大人撒謊。我知道你想引起狩獵大師的注意。哈哈！

scripts.text: I will prove it.
scripts.translation: 我會證明的

scripts.text: Suspicious of Totoy.
scripts.translation: 懷疑托托伊

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Kids tell stories for their own reasons. I'm sure Totoy is the same.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
小孩講故事總有他們的理由。我相信託托伊也是。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh! Really? Bring proof if you really think the kid is telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
哦？真的嗎？如果你真的認為那小孩說的是實話，就帶來證據吧。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Every living thing leaves some kind of trace behind. You also leave behind traces and scents wherever you go. Especially in private places, I mean. He he!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
每個生物都會留下某種痕跡。你也會在你去過的地方留下痕跡和氣味。尤其是在私密的地方，我是說。嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Try collecting 10 Animal Samples from where the kid saw the monster. I will look for traces of that monster from the samples.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
試著在那小孩看到魔物的地方收集10個動物樣本。我會從樣本中尋找那隻魔物的痕跡。

placeholders: (Sex == SEX_MALE) ? "It won't be pleasant but any brave man could easily do it, don't you agree?" : "I don't want the hands of a pretty girl to smell bad but I could care less with someone like you. Ha ha!"
scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
{0}

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh, you're back!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
哦，你回來了！

scripts.text: Let's see if we have a monster in it!
scripts.translation: 讓我們看看裡面有沒有魔物！

scripts.text: I don't think there is a monster.
scripts.translation: 我覺得裡面沒有魔物

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
It was a kid's joke. Ha ha.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
原來是小孩的惡作劇。哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Oh! Really? Bring proof if you really think the kid is telling the truth.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
哦？真的嗎？如果你真的認為那小孩說的是實話，就帶來證據吧。

Every living thing leaves some kind of trace behind. You also leave behind traces and scents wherever you go. Especially in private places, I mean. He he!

每個生物都會留下某種痕跡。你也會在你去過的地方留下痕跡和氣味。尤其是在私密的地方，我是說。嘿嘿！

[Master of Hunting]
Try collecting 10 Animal Samples from where the kid saw the monster. I will look for traces of that monster from the samples.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
試著在那小孩看到魔物的地方收集10個動物樣本。我會從樣本中尋找那隻魔物的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
{0}
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
{0}

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Bring me back samples if you want to prove there is a monster with two heads.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
如果你想證明那裡有雙頭魔物，就帶樣本回來給我看看。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Argh! That's so foul.
You've really brought back the samples.
Ho! Leave it there and come back after washing your hands. Even god won't smile down at you with that stench.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
啊！真噁心。
你居然真的把樣本帶回來了。
嘿！把它放在那裡，先去洗手再回來。帶著這股臭味，連神明都不會保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ho! Shall I?
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
嘿！要我看看嗎？

scripts.text: - Rummaging, fumbling. -
scripts.translation: - 翻找，摸索。 -

scripts.text:
- Rummaging, fumbling. -
- Wriggling, wiggling. -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找，摸索。 -
- 扭動，蠕動。 -

scripts.text:
- Rummaging, fumbling. -
- Wriggling, wiggling. -
- Sway, swag. -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找，摸索。 -
- 扭動，蠕動。 -
- 搖晃，擺動。 -

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ho! This is!!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
嘿！這是！！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Wow! Ho! Ho! Ho! Awesome!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
哇！嘿！嘿！嘿！太棒了！！！！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
You! Come here and feel this!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
你！過來摸摸這個！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Don't just stand there. Touch the sample!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
別光站著。摸摸樣本！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Hurry and tell the Guard Leader that Buwaya is active again. Hurry! You'll find the Guard Leader at the north of the village.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
快去告訴衛隊長，寶箱巨鱷又活躍了。快！衛隊長在村莊的北邊。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Snooze...
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
呼嚕...

scripts.text: - Rummaging, fumbling. -
scripts.translation: - 翻找，摸索。 -

scripts.text:
- Rummaging, fumbling. -
- Wriggling, wiggling. -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找，摸索。 -
- 扭動，蠕動。 -

scripts.text:
- Rummaging, fumbling. -
- Wriggling, wiggling. -
- Sway, swag. -
scripts.translation:
- 翻找，摸索。 -
- 扭動，蠕動。 -
- 搖晃，擺動。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't see anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什麼也沒看到。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
It can't be! Look closer!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
不可能！仔細看！

scripts.text: - Felt something pointy with the end of your fingers. -
scripts.translation: - 指尖觸到了尖銳的東西。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ouch!
What is this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哎喲！
這是什麼？

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ho! This is huge! And so dense that it can easily scratch steel!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
嘿！這好大！而且密度極高，能輕易抓傷鋼鐵！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
This is ^3131FFBuwaya^000000's tooth!
How could this be!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
這是^3131FF寶箱巨鱷^000000的牙齒！
怎麼會這樣！

scripts.text: Buwaya?
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷？

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Ah! Yes! Stop holding it up. It stinks. Go wash your hands.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
啊！對！別舉著了。太臭了。去洗手。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Hmm. The monster the kid saw must be Buwaya. No doubt about it.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
嗯。那個小孩看到的魔物肯定是寶箱巨鱷。毫無疑問。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
I've heard that the wife of the neighbor of my grandfather's uncle on my mom's side was also killed by Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
我聽說，我母親那邊的祖父的叔叔的鄰居的妻子，也是被寶箱巨鱷殺害的。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
They say no living thing is left after Buwaya passes by.
Totoy is one lucky kid. Wow!
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
據說寶箱巨鱷經過之後，不會留下任何活物。
托托伊真是幸運的孩子。哇！

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Buwaya was inactive for a long time. Wonder if it was hibernating? Hmm.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
寶箱巨鱷已經很久沒有活動了。不知道是不是在冬眠？嗯。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Now that I know that a monster like that is out there, I should be cautious, too.
Must tell the villagers not to go too deep into the woods.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
既然知道有那樣的魔物在外面，我也得小心一點。
必須告訴村民們不要深入森林。

scripts.text:
[Master of Hunting]
Please go and tell the Guard Leader that Buwaya is active again.
I will contact other hunters in the meantime and think of a plan to kill Buwaya.
scripts.translation:
[狩獵大師]
請去告訴衛隊長，寶箱巨鱷又活動了。
在此期間，我會聯絡其他獵人，並制定一個消滅寶箱巨鱷的計劃。

scripts.text:
- Wait!! -
- You have too many items on you. -
- Cannot receive the item. -
- Clean up your items -
- And please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你身上的物品太多了。 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請清理你的物品 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text: - You don't have to collect any more samples. -
scripts.translation: - 你不需要再收集任何樣本了。 -

scripts.text: - You see something entangled with soil and grass. -
scripts.translation: - 你看到一些與土壤和草糾纏在一起的東西。 -

scripts.text: - You are nauseous by the foul smell coming from the samples you are collecting. -
scripts.translation: - 你被收集樣本時散發出的惡臭弄得噁心。 -

scripts.text: - You slowing and cautiously collect the squashy and slightly warm substance. -
scripts.translation: - 你緩慢而小心地收集著這種軟綿綿且微溫的物質。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's warm as a mother's bosom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它像母親的懷抱一樣溫暖。

scripts.text:
- Wait!! -
- You have too many items on you. -
- Cannot receive the item. -
- Clean up your items -
- And please try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 你身上的物品太多了。 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請清理你的物品 -
- 然後再試一次。 -

scripts.text: - Look at you warily while whispering to each other. -
scripts.translation: - 警惕地看著你，並互相低聲交談。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
We are busy as hell because of Bangungots servants attacking the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
因為噩夢死神般滾勾特的僕從襲擊醫院，我們忙得不可開交。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
