We are doing our best in securing the safety of our village so please enjoy your stay in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
我們正在全力確保村莊的安全，所以請盡情在馬來港享受您的停留。

scripts.text: Tell him about Buwaya.
scripts.translation: 告訴他關於寶箱巨鱷的事

scripts.text: Done with conversation.
scripts.translation: 結束對話

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya? The merciless creature is back?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷？那個無情的生物又回來了？

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That's bad news. We are already short-handed by assigning everyone to fight off Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
這是個壞訊息。我們已經人手不足，因為所有人都被派去對抗噩夢死神般滾勾特了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
And villagers need to go to the woods to collect fruits and vegetables.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
而且村民們需要去森林採集水果和蔬菜。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hmm... will you be able to help Port Malaya?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
嗯...你能幫助馬來港嗎？

scripts.text: Leave it to me!
scripts.translation: 交給我吧！

scripts.text: I'm pretty busy myself.
scripts.translation: 我自己也挺忙的

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Really? That's no good. All the lives of the villagers will be at stake if we don't do something. How can a youth like you be so heartless. Are all outsiders like you? Hmph! Can't trust young people these days. Hmph.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
真的嗎？這可不好。如果我們不採取行動，村民們的生命都將受到威脅。像你這樣的年輕人怎麼能如此冷酷無情。難道所有外人都像你們一樣嗎？哼！現在的年輕人真不可信。哼。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I knew I could count on you.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
我就知道可以指望你。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good. I will trust you.
I need to know where Buwaya will likely appear in order to secure villagers living area.
Guess Buwayas nest will be the best bet.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
很好，我相信你。
為了保障村民們的居住區安全，我需要知道寶箱巨鱷可能出沒的地方。
寶箱巨鱷的巢穴應該是最有可能的地點。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
^3131FF到達該區域後，投擲一枚火煙瓶^000000。
然後我們會向火煙瓶投擲的方向趕去。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Then take care and good luck.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
那麼，請多加小心，祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
^3131FFShoot a smoke bomb^000000 once you reach the area.
Then we will run to where the smoke bomb was shot.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
^3131FF到達該區域後，投擲一枚火煙瓶^000000。
然後我們會向火煙瓶投擲的方向趕去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's first bring Ed to Totoy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們先把艾德帶到托托伊那裡吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
The Guard Leader gave you the location of Buwaya's cave.
This can't be happening.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
衛隊長告訴了你寶箱巨鱷洞穴的位置。
這不可能發生。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I'm way out of men to assign to the Buwaya situation but well have to do something with what we got.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
我手下的兵力不足以應對寶箱巨鱷的情況，但我們必須用現有的人力做點什麼。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Here, this is a symbol of our gratitude.
If you would like to help with Buwaya again, please look for me.
Hope you have a great journey.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
拿著，這是我們的謝禮。
如果你願意再次協助處理寶箱巨鱷的問題，請隨時來找我。
祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Hear Buwaya appeared from the depth of the Forest.
As everyone knows, all our manpower is dispatched to handle Bangungots servants attacking the hospital recently.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
聽說寶箱巨鱷從普勒斯特深處出現了。
眾所周知，我們所有的人力最近都調去應對噩夢死神般滾勾特的部下襲擊醫院了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
That is why we have no choice but to ask an outsider to help eliminate Buwaya.
They say Buwaya is a very strong and ugly monster with two heads.
Will you help us defeat Buwaya?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
所以我們別無選擇，只能請求外人幫忙消滅寶箱巨鱷。
據說寶箱巨鱷是一種很強壯且醜陋的雙頭魔物。
你願意幫助我們擊敗寶箱巨鱷嗎？

scripts.text: Of course.
scripts.translation: 當然可以。

scripts.text: Nope.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷以極其危險著稱。
拒絕這個請求並不丟人。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
This mission will be a dangerous one.
If you want to help get rid of Buwaya, you must be prepared.
Come back once you reach LV 130.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
這項任務非常危險。
如果你想幫忙消滅寶箱巨鱷，必須做好充分準備。
達到130級後再回來吧。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
According to the legend, Buwaya kidnaps people and puts them in the sack on its back and then eats them later.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
根據傳說，寶箱巨鱷會綁架人類，把他們裝進背上的袋子裡，然後再吃掉他們。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
請記住這一點，時刻保持警惕。
我建議找值得信賴的同伴一起行動。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
How is it going with the Buwaya situation?
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷的情況怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放棄了。

scripts.text: Still fighting.
scripts.translation: 還在戰鬥中。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Keep this in mind and be cautious at all times.
I recommend asking trustful colleagues for help.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
請記住這一點，時刻保持警惕。
我建議找值得信賴的同伴一起行動。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Buwaya is known to be a very dangerous monster.
There is no shame in rejecting this request.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
寶箱巨鱷以極其危險著稱。
拒絕這個請求並不丟人。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Can't believe you really got rid of Buwaya!
You aren't just any ordinary youth, aren't you? People of Port Malaya can now sleep at night.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
真不敢相信你真的消滅了寶箱巨鱷！
你可不是普通的年輕人啊。馬來港的人們現在可以安心睡覺了。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
Good work.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Guard Leader]
I will not stand down until all of Port Malaya, including Baryo Mahiwaga, is safe from Buwaya. Promise to take care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[衛隊長]
在馬來港包括Baryo Mahiwaga在內的所有地方都擺脫寶箱巨鱷的威脅之前，我不會撤職的。答應我，你要照顧好自己。

scripts.text: Bark bark!!
scripts.translation: 汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why is a dog here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡怎麼會有隻狗？

scripts.text: Look closely at the dog.
scripts.translation: 仔細看看這隻狗

scripts.text: Ignore it.
scripts.translation: 無視它

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Looks like a lost dog.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看起來像是隻走丟的狗。

scripts.text: - Looked real hard at the dirty dog and noticed an old collar on its neck. -
scripts.translation: - 你仔細打量著這隻髒兮兮的狗，發現它脖子上戴著一箇舊項圈。 -

scripts.text: - The collar says, 'Forever with Totoy'. -
scripts.translation: - 項圈上寫著“永遠與托托伊在一起”。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So you are Ed?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
原來你是艾德啊。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You didn't get killed by Buwaya. You lucky little dog. Let's go back to your owner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你居然沒被寶箱巨鱷吃掉。真是隻幸運的小狗。我們帶你去找你的主人吧。

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah, before we go, do you happen to know where Buwaya's nest is?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊，在走之前，你知道寶箱巨鱷的巢穴在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Woof!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪！

scripts.text: - Ed is one smart dog and understood what you asked him. Ed started to bark towards the north. -
scripts.translation: - 艾德是一隻很聰明的狗，它聽懂了你的話。艾德開始朝北方吠叫。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Buwaya is over there!
Then I should shoot the smoke bomb here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
寶箱巨鱷在那邊！
那我應該在這裡發射火煙瓶。

scripts.text: - You take the smoke bomb out of your inventory and shoot towards the sky. -
scripts.translation: - 你從物品欄裡拿出火煙瓶，向天空發射。 -

scripts.text:
[Guard]
Job well done!
So Buwaya lives in remote place like this. I will make sure this information goes to the Guard Leader!
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
幹得好！
原來寶箱巨鱷住在這種偏僻的地方。我會確保把這個情報傳達給衛隊長！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I return Ed to Totoy first and then go see the Guard Leader?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我應該先把艾德送回給托托伊，然後再去找衛隊長嗎？

scripts.text:
[Dog]
Bark bark!
scripts.translation:
[狗]
汪汪！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Lets first bring Ed to Totoy and then go back to the Guard Leader.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先把艾德送回給托托伊，然後再去找衛隊長吧。

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Story of dragon that lives at a lake~
Story of an old lady
that became a dragon long ago~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
住在湖裡的龍的故事~
一位老婦人
很久以前變成了龍~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
Waiting for the son that left for a foreign land,
my son will return
when that moon sets for the 90th time
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
等待那個去異國他鄉的兒子，
當月亮落下第九十次時，
我的兒子就會回來

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The moon sets for the 89th,
The moon sets for the 90th,
The moon sets for the 191st...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
月亮落下第八十九次，
月亮落下第九十次，
月亮落下第一百九十一次...

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
That moon has taken my son away~
That horrible thing
has swallowed my son,
and I will punish that moon~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
那輪月亮奪走了我的兒子~
那可怕的東西
吞掉了我的兒子，
我要懲罰那輪月亮~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The day the furious moon hides itself from sight,
the whole world will be flooded with rain
with all the villages and people facing death under water~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
當憤怒的月亮躲藏起來時，
整個世界將被雨水淹沒，
所有的村莊和人民都將在水下走向死亡~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
The old lady's curse made the moon furious~
Get rid of the old lady to calm the moon~
If only the old lady wasn't here, If only the old lady wasn't here...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
老婦人的詛咒讓月亮變得憤怒~
趕走老婦人，讓月亮平息~
要是老婦人不在就好了，要是老婦人不在就好了...

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
I hear rumors~
The old lady threw herself into the lake~
the old lady, now turned into a dragon, will swallow the moon
and soon swallow the village too~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
我聽到傳聞~
老婦人跳進了湖裡~
老婦人變成了龍，將吞掉月亮，
很快也會吞掉這個村莊~

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
You say the legend is all a lie?
You mean my ancestors are all liars
and swindlers?
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
你說傳說都是謊言？
你是說我祖先都是騙子
和欺詐者嗎？

scripts.text:
[Singing Man]
This village is built on an old legend
and history.
They are not the kind of people that will be shaken by
foolish words of an imbecile such as yourself.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的男子]
這個村莊建立在古老的傳說
和歷史之上。
我們不是那種會被
像你這樣的傻瓜的胡言亂語動搖的人。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Bakonawa that live at a lake,
story of an old lady that became a dragon.
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
住在湖裡的巴庫暴龍，
一位老婦人變成了龍的故事。

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The son that was suppose to return after the moon sets for the 90th time
never did come back even after the moon had set for a few hundred times~
The moon has swallowed the old lady's son~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
那個本該在月亮落下第九十次時回來的兒子，
即使月亮落下幾百次也沒有回來~
月亮吞掉了老婦人的兒子~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, you shall receive the old lady's curse~
The whole village was immersed in death
with rain and floods sent by the furious moon~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
月亮，月亮，你將承受老婦人的詛咒~
整個村莊都沉浸在死亡之中，
被憤怒的月亮帶來的雨水和洪水淹沒~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The moon, the moon, be still and be calm,
for the old lady is gone and she is no more~
The old lady has drowned in the lake~
She will transform into Bakonawa and come back...
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
月亮，月亮，請安靜，請平息，
因為老婦人已經離去，不再存在~
老婦人淹死在湖裡~
她將變成巴庫暴龍回來...

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
...to swallow you and
punish the village soon~
The day the moon dies
is the day the village dies too~
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
...吞掉你，
並很快懲罰這個村莊~
月亮死去的那一天，
也是村莊死去的那一天~

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
The legends are all a lie?
Why do you say such nonsense?
Is there nothing
that is important for you to protect?
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
傳說都是謊言？
你為什麼要說這種胡話？
難道沒有什麼
是你覺得重要並想要守護的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Singing Woman]
Poor Bakonawa...
I would be happy
if she took a big bite out of someone like you!
scripts.translation:
[唱歌的女子]
可憐的巴庫暴龍...
如果它能狠狠咬你一口，
我會很高興的！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The vicious monster Bakonawa will soon come
to swallow the moon and take vengeance upon the village.
I'm scared, please help...
scripts.translation:
[受驚的男孩]
可怕的魔物巴庫暴龍很快就要來了，
它將吞掉月亮，並向村莊復仇。
我很害怕，請幫幫我...

scripts.text:
[Frightened Boy]
The legend of Bakonawa is all a lie?
So that means Bakonawa doesn't exist?
I'm going to play with my friends at the lake later.
You told me it was all a lie right?
scripts.translation:
[受驚的男孩]
巴庫暴龍的傳說都是謊言？
那意思是巴庫暴龍不存在？
我稍後要去湖邊和朋友們玩。
你剛才說那都是謊言對吧？

scripts.text: - She seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 她似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is said that Bakonawa hates loud noises.
Pound the pot if you want to live!
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
據說巴庫暴龍討厭巨大的噪音。
想活命就敲鍋吧！

scripts.text: Hates loud noises?
scripts.translation: 討厭巨大的噪音？

scripts.text: What is Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 什麼是巴庫暴龍？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
You already heard that the old lady
died and became Bakonawa, right?
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
你已經聽說那位老婦人死後變成了巴庫暴龍，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The legend has it that
the old lady had very keen hearing
because she was always focusing on
the returning of her traveling son.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
傳說那位老婦人聽力極佳，
因為她總是全神貫注地等待遠行的兒子歸來。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
So naturally, Bakonawa also
has very keen hearing.
The reason why everyone is banging
pots and pans is because of this.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
因此，巴庫暴龍自然也有著極佳的聽力。
大家之所以拼命敲打鍋碗瓢盆，就是因為這個原因。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
It is a terrible monster that lives at a lake.
We are all trembling with fear
because we don't know when it might attack the village.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
它是一種棲息在湖中的可怕魔物。
我們都在恐懼中顫抖，
因為不知道它何時會襲擊村莊。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
Some say that it is more obsessed with swallowing the moon
than attacking the village.
if that's the case, I wish it would just swallow the moon
and leave us alone.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
有人說它比起襲擊村莊，
更痴迷於吞食月亮。
如果是這樣，我希望它乾脆吞掉月亮，
然後放過我們。

scripts.text:
[Frightened Maiden]
The villagers hate you now.
You've been saying that legend of Bakonawa
is a lie and they are saying you are more of a monster
than Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[受驚的少女]
村民們現在很討厭你。
你一直說巴庫暴龍的傳說是謊言，
他們說比起巴庫暴龍，你更像是一個魔物。

scripts.text: - Old Fortune Teller seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 年老的占卜師似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
You must not hate Bakonawa.
The hate against it is only feeding its rage
to grow bigger.
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜師]
你不應該憎恨巴庫暴龍。
對它的憎恨只會助長它的怒火，
讓怒火變得更大。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
To calm the dead lady's anger,
we annually hold a ceremony and prepare food.
But there seems to be no way to calm the
ever growing anger of the old lady.
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜師]
為了平息那位逝者女士的憤怒，
我們每年都會舉行儀式並準備食物。
但似乎沒有任何辦法能平息
那位老婦人日益增長的憤怒。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
The day is nearing. I can sense it.
Bakonawa will soon swallow the moon
and come to punish the village.
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜師]
日子快到了，我能感覺到。
巴庫暴龍很快會吞食月亮，
然後來懲罰這個村莊。

scripts.text:
[Old Fortune Teller]
How can you say the legend is a lie!
Because of you, the fury of Bakonawa
grew even larger!
If the village perishes,
it is all your fault!
scripts.translation:
[年老的占卜師]
你怎麼能說傳說是謊言！
因為你的緣故，巴庫暴龍的怒火
變得更加猛烈了！
如果村莊毀滅了，
這都是你的錯！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 無法開始對話。你攜帶的物品太多了。-

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is something that needs to be done
but you look too fragile
to give me a hand.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
有一件事需要去做，
但你看起來太虛弱了，
無法幫我一把。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Come back when
your strength grows strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
等你變得足夠強壯，
能夠匹敵惡魔侍者時，
再回來吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady has come back
to life as Bakonawa.
Soon she will come to take vengeance on the village.
We must calm her
if to prevent further destruction...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
那位老婦人已經復活為巴庫暴龍。
很快她就會回來向村莊復仇。
我們必須平息她的怒火，
以防止進一步的破壞...

scripts.text: Calm Bakonawa?
scripts.translation: 平息巴庫暴龍？

scripts.text: Further destruction?
scripts.translation: 進一步的破壞？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The old lady faced an unjust death
because of villagers' selfishness.
She was a caring mother who loved her
son dearly.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
那位老婦人因為村民的自私而遭受了不公正的死亡。
她是一位慈愛的母親，非常疼愛她的兒子。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If we track the whereabouts of her son and hold a ritual
with her son's belongings,
her restless soul will be calmed
and she will spare us from destruction.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
如果我們追蹤她兒子的下落，並用她兒子的遺物舉行儀式，
她不安的靈魂就會得到平息，
她就會放過我們，不再破壞村莊。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
It is no use sir!!
scripts.translation:
[村民們]
沒用的，先生！！

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
You cannot stop the monster that way!
scripts.translation:
[村民們]
那樣是阻止不了魔物的！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Of course, it will not be easy to track down the whereabouts of a person
who has been gone for a hundred years.
...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
當然，要追蹤一個失蹤了百年的人的下落，絕非易事。
...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Still, don't you think
it is worth a try?
Please help us and save us from our misery.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
不過，您不覺得值得一試嗎？
請幫幫我們，救我們脫離苦海。

scripts.text: It is no use.
scripts.translation: 沒用的

scripts.text: I'll help.
scripts.translation: 我會幫忙的。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Yes, you are also right.
You are up against not a human,
but a monster.
Still, I trust in that old lady's
good heart.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
是的，您說得也有道理。
您面對的不是人類，而是魔物。
不過，我依然相信那位老婦人的善心。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Will you do it?
According to the legend,
the old lady's son was limping
and was a traveling merchant that sold wooden dolls.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
您願意去做嗎？
根據傳說，那位老婦人的兒子是個跛子，
是個販賣木製玩偶的旅行商人。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is a ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000 he left.
But the piece is small and damaged,
its hard to identify it.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
他留下了一塊^FF0000石板碎片^000000。
但碎片很小且已破損，
很難辨認。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
First, bring it to me.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
首先，把它帶給我。
沿著這條路往下走，
您會在港口附近遇到我的孫女。
從她那裡拿到石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The grudge against the people of
Bakonawa- I mean, the dead old lady.
The moon and this village...
She will try to destroy it.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
她對巴庫暴龍——我是說，那位已故老婦人的怨恨。
月亮和這個村莊...
她會試圖摧毀這一切。

scripts.text: Take vengeance? After all these years?
scripts.translation: 復仇？這麼多年過去了？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
For some time, she has
blamed the moon and
resented the villagers.
The feeling grew larger as the time passed.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
有一段時間，她一直責怪月亮，
並怨恨村民們。
隨著時間流逝，這種情緒越來越強烈。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why do you think she became such a monster?
What do you think went through her head
for years and years?
Anger and vengeance.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
您覺得她為什麼變成了這樣的魔物？
您覺得她在漫長的歲月裡，
腦海中在想什麼？
憤怒和復仇。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Unforgettable grudge
that she was abandoned.
against the moon and the village.
This is why this grudge must be resolved.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
被拋棄的難忘怨恨，
針對月亮和村莊。
這就是為什麼必須解決這份怨恨。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Please bring the ^FF0000Slate Piece^000000.
Down along this path
you will meet my granddaughter near the port.
Get the Slate Piece from there.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
請帶來那塊^FF0000石板碎片^000000。
沿著這條路往下走，
您會在港口附近遇到我的孫女。
從她那裡拿到石板碎片。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Good, you have the Slate Piece.
Hold on to it and don't lose it.
It will be of helpful in tracking down the legend.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
很好，您有石板碎片了。
請保管好它，別弄丟了。
它在追蹤傳說時會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I heard there is a man that lives by himself
at the end of northwestern part of Forest Field.
I heard someone saw a wooden doll there.
It is such a remote place that people like us
simply cannot travel there.
Could you visit the place for us?
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
我聽說在普勒斯特西北部的盡頭，
住著一個獨居的男人。
我聽說有人在那裡看到了木製玩偶。
那個地方太偏僻了，
像我們這樣的人根本無法前往。
您能替我們去那裡看看嗎？

scripts.text: Go there yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: Your explanation is too vague.
scripts.translation: 你的解釋太模糊了。

scripts.text: On my way!
scripts.translation: 我出發了！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You twisted youth!
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
你這不知好歹的年輕人！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a point, but
this is the best I can do for now.
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
您說得對，
但目前我只能做到這個程度了。
那個地方在森林西北部的盡頭。
過了橋再往西走，
您就會看到一個人。
祝您好運...為了我們...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
You have a good heart young man!
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
You will see a ^0000FFMalaya Immigrant^000000.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
您是個心地善良的年輕人！
那個地方在森林西北部的盡頭。
過了橋再往西走，
您就會看到一位^0000FF馬拉雅移民^000000。
祝您好運...為了我們...

scripts.text: Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation: 祝您好運...為了我們...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The place is at the end of northwestern part of the forest.
After you pass the bridge and travel west,
you will see a person.
Good luck to you... for our sake...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
那個地方在森林西北部的盡頭。
過了橋再往西走，
您就會看到一個人。
祝您好運...為了我們...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The track of the old lady's son
is connected all the way to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
There is a chance he wasn't a merchant...
I'm really curious about who he was...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
老婦人的兒子的蹤跡
竟然一直通到
巴里奧·馬希瓦加？
看來他可能不是商人...
我真好奇他到底是誰...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Why did you come back here
instead of going straight to
Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
您為什麼回到這裡，
而不是直接去
巴里奧·馬希瓦加？

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
Is that really true?
Bakonawa turning into an old lady
and fabricating the legend...
It seems all the villagers up until now
have been manipulated by that terrible monster.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
這是真的嗎？
巴庫暴龍變成老婦人
編造傳說...
看來直到現在的村民們
都被那隻可怕的魔物操控了。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
There is no reason to hesitate then.
You must go into Bakonawa's lair
before it attacks first.
I believe we can trust you to do this, yes?
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
既然如此，就沒有猶豫的理由了。
您必須在它發動攻擊之前
進入巴庫暴龍的巢穴。
我相信您能完成這件事，對嗎？

scripts.text: Well...
Of course!
scripts.translation: 當然！

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The atmosphere was really good
but suddenly it's all ruined.
I didn't expect you to be so shy...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
氣氛本來很好，
結果一下子全毀了。
沒想到您這麼害羞...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
I will speak to
the village chief for you
so that you can enter the Bakonawa Lake.
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
我會替您向村長求情，
讓您能進入食月暴龍湖。
請替我們除掉這隻魔物。

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
If you don't mind,
could you lend a hand to the Village Chief?
Nobody cares for each other anymore
because of Bakonawa...
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
如果您不介意，
能幫幫村長嗎？
因為巴庫暴龍，
大家都不再互相關心了...

scripts.text:
[Old Legend Teller]
The legend that
we believed for a hundred years,
all lies....
Please get rid of this monster for us.
scripts.translation:
[古老傳說的講述者]
我們信奉了百年的傳說，
竟然全是謊言....
請替我們除掉這隻魔物。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
您一定很有勇氣，
才會來到這麼偏僻的地方。
最近馬來港怎麼樣了？
我聽說住在湖裡的魔物巴庫暴龍
正在威脅村民們。
因為我一直待在這裡，
對那裡的情況一無所知。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a brave heart
to come to such a remote place.
How is Port Malaya these days?
I heard the monster that lives at the lake, Baknoawa
is threatening the villagers.
I am in the dark about what is going on because I'm here all the time.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
您一定很有勇氣，
才會來到這麼偏僻的地方。
最近馬來港怎麼樣了？
我聽說住在湖裡的魔物巴庫暴龍
正在威脅村民們。
因為我一直待在這裡，
對那裡的情況一無所知。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Are you the traveling merchant who used to sell Wooden Doll, right?
I don't know about any traveling merchant, but by Wooden Doll
(going through things) do you mean this?
I don't know about the specifics, but
I think it's related to what I heard long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
您就是那個以前賣木製玩偶的旅行商人，對嗎？
我不認識什麼旅行商人，但您說的木製玩偶
（翻找東西）是指這個嗎？
我不太清楚具體細節，但
我覺得這和我很久以前聽到的事有關。

scripts.text: What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 你來這裡做什麼？

scripts.text: Do you know about this Slate Piece?
scripts.translation: 您知道這塊石板塗鴉嗎？

scripts.text: Please tell me the story.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我那個故事。

scripts.text: Who is the traveling merchant?
scripts.translation: 那個旅行商人是誰？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I liked the environment here
so I decided to stay and live.
There is no obligation here.
To me, that's as good as heaven.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
我很喜歡這裡的環境，
所以決定留下來生活。
這裡沒有束縛。
對我來說，這就如同天堂。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It is a very old Slate Piece.
I'm sorry but I never seen this before.
There is some kind of writing here
but I can't make it out.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
這是一塊非常古老的石板塗鴉。
抱歉，我以前從未見過。
上面有一些文字，
但我認不出來。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's a simple story.
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
故事很簡單。
^0000FF一位我從未見過的受傷男子^000000
^0000FF來到我家尋求幫助。^000000
^0000FF痊癒後，他製作了一個木製玩偶^000000

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil spirits ^000000
^0000FFas a token of gratitude,^000000
^0000FFand left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
^0000FF據說那是用來驅趕邪惡精靈的^000000
^0000FF作為感謝的禮物，^000000
^0000FF然後他前往了Baryo Mahiwaga。^000000

scripts.text: He left for Baryo Mahiwaga?
scripts.translation: 他去了Baryo Mahiwaga？

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
According to what I've heard
that's correct. But the story has been
passed on from mouth to mouth for a
long time. I can't be sure.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
據我所知是這樣的。但這個故事口耳相傳了很久，
我無法確定其真實性。

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
從Baryo Mahiwaga村莊出發，使用關鍵詞^0000FF馬拉雅^000000，
或者^0000FF巴庫暴龍^000000，
也許能查出那個旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is a lack of information
so I can't make say for sure but
I'm skeptical if he was in fact even a merchant.
Coming to a town with a
critical wound seems too suspicious...
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
嗯，由於資訊不足，我無法斷定，
但我懷疑他是否真的是商人。
帶著重傷來到城鎮，這似乎太可疑了...

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
And craving a Wooden Doll
could be seen to have some kind of ritualistic meaning.
Protecting one from some evil force...
that kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
而且執著於木製玩偶，
可能具有某種儀式意義。
保護某人免受邪惡力量侵害...
之類的事情。

scripts.text:
Identity of the traveling merchant...
Looks like there is one more
mystery to be solved.
I suppose it will all come to light
soon enough.
scripts.translation:
旅行商人的身份...
看來還有一個謎團待解。
我想很快真相就會大白了。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I will tell you again slowly
the story that has been passed on.
Listen carefully and repeat...
no, I mean, you don't have repeat it.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
我會再慢慢講一遍那個口耳相傳的故事。
請仔細聽並複述...
不，我的意思是，你不需要複述。

scripts.text:
[Orally Transmitted Story]
^0000FFA wounded man who I had never seen before^000000
^0000FFcame to my house and asked for help.^000000
^0000FFOnce healed, as a token of gratitude, he made a Wooden Doll^000000
^0000FFthat is suppose to chase away evil sprits.^000000
^0000FFThen he left for Baryo Mahiwaga.^000000
scripts.translation:
[口耳相傳的故事]
^0000FF一位我從未見過的受傷男子^000000
^0000FF來到我家尋求幫助。^000000
^0000FF痊癒後，作為感謝，他製作了一個木製玩偶^000000
^0000FF據說那是用來驅趕邪惡精靈的。^000000
^0000FF然後他前往了Baryo Mahiwaga。^000000

scripts.text:
From Baryo Mahiwaga village, using keyword ^0000FFMalaya^000000,
or ^0000FFBakonawa^000000,
maybe I could find out the identity and whereabouts
of the traveling merchant.
scripts.translation:
從Baryo Mahiwaga村莊出發，使用關鍵詞^0000FF馬拉雅^000000，
或者^0000FF巴庫暴龍^000000，
也許能查出那個旅行商人的身份和下落。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Have you been to
Port Malaya?
I am curious to know
what is going on there
but I can't travel because there are monsters everywhere.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
你去過馬來港嗎？
我很好奇那裡發生了什麼，
但我無法前往，因為到處都是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Wooden Doll?
There is a tale related to that,
but you didn't come all the way
just to hear some folktale right?
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
木製玩偶？
有一個相關的傳說，
但你不會大老遠跑來只是為了聽個民間故事吧？

scripts.text: I just came here to take a break.
scripts.translation: 我只是來這裡休息一下。

scripts.text: Tell me the tale.
scripts.translation: 告訴我那個傳說。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
You must have a lot of free time on your hands!
I'm no travel agent
so go bother someone else!
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
你肯定有很多空閒時間吧！
我又不是旅行社，
去找別人問吧！

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
It's baloney
so I don't really remember the details.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
那是胡扯，
所以我也不記得具體細節了。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
to the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事梗概]
很久以前，5名劍士
與魔物巴庫暴龍戰鬥。
四人戰死，一人給魔物留下了致命傷，
但自己的腿也受了重傷。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事梗概]
逃離現場後，巴庫暴龍變成了人類，
秘密追蹤那名劍士。
劍士製作了一個木製玩偶，
可以阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
This is the end of story.
Without any conclusion...
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
故事到此結束。
沒有結局...

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I heard there is a record that the swordsman left
but I don't understand why
he would leave it here in such a distant place
here instead of Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
我聽說劍士留下了記錄，
但我不明白他為什麼
會把它留在這個遙遠的地方，
而不是馬拉雅。

scripts.text: I wish to see the record.
scripts.translation: 我想看看那份記錄。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The record is engraved on the stone ahead.
However, the stone is so badly
damaged and some pieces fell out that
it will be hard to make the words out.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
記錄刻在前方那塊石頭上。
不過石頭破損嚴重，
有些碎片脫落了，
很難辨認上面的文字。

scripts.text: Investigate the stone ahead.
scripts.translation: 調查前方的石頭。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
The stone ahead holds a record that
a swordsman from a long time ago left.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
前方的石頭上刻著
很久以前一名劍士留下的記錄。

scripts.text: Where did this swordsman go after?
scripts.translation: 這名劍士後來去了哪裡？

scripts.text: Tell me the tale again.
scripts.translation: 再給我講講這個故事。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
Well, there is no story after that so
I guess nobody would know what happened.
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
嗯，之後就沒有故事了，
所以我想沒人知道後來發生了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事梗概]
很久以前，5名劍士
與魔物巴庫暴龍戰鬥。
四人戰死，一人給魔物留下了致命傷，
但自己的腿也受了重傷。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事梗概]
逃離現場後，巴庫暴龍變成了人類，
秘密追蹤那名劍士。
劍士製作了一個木製玩偶，
可以阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
[Malaya Immigrant]
I suppose you wish to hear the story again right?
No problem! I can tell this story forever!
scripts.translation:
[馬拉雅移民]
我想你是想再聽一遍這個故事吧？
沒問題！這個故事我可以講上一輩子！

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
Long time ago, 5 swordsmen fought
against the monster Bakonawa.
Four died and one left a critical wound
on the monster but in return
sustained a serious wound in his leg himself.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事梗概]
很久以前，5名劍士
與魔物巴庫暴龍戰鬥。
四人戰死，一人給魔物留下了致命傷，
但自己的腿也受了重傷。

scripts.text:
[Summary of the folktale]
After escaping the scene, Bakonawa transformed into a human
and secretly pursued the swordsman.
The swordsman made a Wooden Doll that
can keep the monster from approaching.
scripts.translation:
[民間故事梗概]
逃離現場後，巴庫暴龍變成了人類，
秘密追蹤那名劍士。
劍士製作了一個木製玩偶，
可以阻止魔物靠近。

scripts.text:
The damage is so severe
that the record is unidentifiable.
When inserting the Slate Piece
to a hole on the wall, it fits perfectly like a piece of puzzle.
The letters are not clear but you can still read it.
scripts.translation:
損壞得太嚴重了，
記錄無法辨認。
將石板碎片
嵌入牆上的孔洞時，
它像拼圖一樣完美契合。
字跡雖然模糊，
但依然可以閱讀。

scripts.text:
Here is the record left by a swordsman
from a hundred years ago.
scripts.translation: 這是百年前一名劍士留下的記錄。

scripts.text: I don't need to read it.
scripts.translation: 我不需要閱讀它。

scripts.text: Read the record again.
scripts.translation: 再讀一遍記錄。

scripts.text:
I remember the story clearly.
Let's tell the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000 in Malaya
about what I discovered.
scripts.translation:
我清楚地記得這個故事。
讓我去馬拉雅告訴^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000
我的發現。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
After fighting with Bakonawa, I sustained a critical wound
and came to this place.
Only thing I can do is
Place the Wooden Doll in one place
the monster would come.
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
在與巴庫暴龍戰鬥後，我受了致命傷，
來到了這裡。
我能做的只有
將木製玩偶放在
魔物會來的地方。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
^0000FFSometimes transforming into a child, or even a old lady,^000000
I know that ^0000FFBakonawa^000000has been
chasing after me in secret to kill me.
Because of that critical injury the monster * sustained,
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
^0000FF有時它變成孩子，甚至老婦人，^000000
我知道^0000FF巴庫暴龍^000000一直在
暗中追蹤我，想要殺我。
因為那道致命傷，

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
** it will need nearly a hundred years
for Bakonawa to absorb the power of the moon
to fully recover its power.
Beware of the day the moon disappears.
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
**巴庫暴龍需要將近一百年
吸收月亮的力量
才能完全恢復實力。
當心月亮消失的那一天。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
The day will come when Bakonawa
will run amuck.
But it will take nearly a hundred years to fully recover its power.
There will always be someone better than me
to defeat the vile creature.
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
巴庫暴龍肆虐的日子終將到來。
但它需要將近一百年才能完全恢復實力。
總會有比我更優秀的人
擊敗這邪惡的生物。

scripts.text:
[Record left by a swordsman from a hundred years ago]
I will place my trust in the one that will replace me ages from now...
scripts.translation:
[百年前劍士留下的記錄]
我將把希望寄託在
未來接替我的那個人身上...

scripts.text:
How could this be...
Lie told by Bakonawa when it turned into an old lady
in order to take revenge on the swordsman
turned into a legend after all these years.
scripts.translation:
怎麼會這樣...
巴庫暴龍變成老婦人時編造的謊言，
為了向劍士復仇，
竟然在這麼多年後變成了傳說。

scripts.text:
I found out that Bakonawa
is nothing but a blood thirsty monster.
I must tell what I know to the ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
in Malaya.
scripts.translation:
我發現巴庫暴龍
不過是一個嗜血的魔物。
我必須去馬拉雅告訴^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000
我所知道的一切。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Grandpa believes
Bakonawa can
turn good.
Do you think it's possible?
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
爺爺相信
巴庫暴龍是可以變好的。
你覺得有可能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
^FF0000Slate Piece^000000?
Why would you need something
that is barely recognizable?
I'll give it to you if you want.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
^FF0000石板碎片^000000？
為什麼你需要一個
幾乎無法辨認的東西？
如果你想要的話，我就給你。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然我有了石板碎片，
現在就去見^FF0000古老傳說的講述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Please take this Slate Piece
and deliver it to my grandpa.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
請收下這塊石板碎片，
並把它交給我的爺爺。

scripts.text:
Let's go to the
^FF0000Old Legend Teller^000000
now that I have the Slate Piece.
scripts.translation:
既然我有了石板碎片，
現在就去見^FF0000古老傳說的講述者^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man's Granddaughter]
Because of Bakonawa,
the village is always unpeaceful.
scripts.translation:
[老人的孫女]
因為巴庫暴龍，
村莊總是不得安寧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Man]
Calm Bakonawa?
Do you know how many people have been
sacrificed by Bakonawa?
I will fight on my own if I have to!
scripts.translation:
[憤怒的男子]
安撫巴庫暴龍？
你知道有多少人
被巴庫暴龍殺害了嗎？
如果有必要，我會獨自戰鬥！

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Calm Little Girl]
It is too dangerous to fight against
Bakonawa. There is a chance
it will get more angry and put children and
elders in danger.
scripts.translation:
[冷靜的小女孩]
與巴庫暴龍戰鬥太危險了。
它可能會變得更加憤怒，
從而危及孩子和老人的安全。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Angry Boy]
I lost my father and my friend
to that Bakonawa.
I will surely revenge them!
scripts.translation:
[憤怒的男孩]
我的父親和朋友
都死在那隻巴庫暴龍手裡。
我一定要為他們報仇！

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 無法開始對話。你攜帶的物品太多了。-

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm desperate for a helping hand
but you look
too weak and fragile.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我急需幫手，
但你看起來
太弱小、太脆弱了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please come back when
you grow strong enough
to match Incubus.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
等你變得足夠強大，
能夠匹敵惡魔侍者時，
再回來吧。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I'm don't know what's the right decision.
To fight against Bakonawa,
or calm it by offering it a sacrificial gift.
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我不知道什麼才是正確的決定。
是去對抗巴庫暴龍，
還是獻上祭品來安撫它。
最近，被巴庫暴龍傷害的人越來越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The legend was all a lie?
It seems all the villagers up until now
were manipulated by that vile monster.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
傳說竟然全是謊言？
看來一直以來，
村民們都被那隻邪惡的魔物操控了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Recently, there have been more people that have
been harmed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
最近，被巴庫暴龍傷害的人越來越多了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
There are some missing villagers
but I can't find out if
they are simply missing or if they have been
killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
有一些村民失蹤了，
但我無法確定
他們只是失蹤了，
還是已經被巴庫暴龍殺害了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I heard that the belongings of the missing people
are being found at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
Please go there to find ^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
and give them to the families of
the missing people
in whatever amount they want.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我聽說失蹤者的物品
出現在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原。
請去那裡尋找^0000FF丟失的物品^000000，
並將它們交給失蹤者的家人，
數量由他們決定。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
^0000FFLost Belongings^000000
are said to be carried by
^FF0000Tiyanak^000000 that roams Baryo Mahiwaga.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
據說^0000FF丟失的物品^000000
是被在巴里奧·馬希瓦加遊蕩的
^FF0000惡魔嬰兒^000000攜帶的。

scripts.text: Do it yourself.
scripts.translation: 我自己去做

scripts.text: I'm on my way.
scripts.translation: 我這就去

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
You give me a lot to think about.
Leave the village at once.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
你讓我有很多事要思考。
立刻離開村莊。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Let's start then. First,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and take them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
那就開始吧。首先，
從惡魔嬰兒那裡奪回兩件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的父親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
From Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
retrieve two ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Father^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從遊蕩在巴里奧·馬希瓦加草原的惡魔嬰兒那裡，
奪回兩件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的父親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve Seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從惡魔嬰兒那裡奪回七件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從惡魔嬰兒那裡奪回三件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的兒子^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000
for me.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
從惡魔嬰兒那裡奪回五件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並替我交給^0000FF失蹤者的母親^000000。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
So it's clear that all the missing people
have been killed by Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
看來所有失蹤者
都被巴庫暴龍殺害了。

scripts.text:
[Villagers]
Kill Bakonawa!
Let's get rid of the monster ourselves!
scripts.translation:
[村民們]
殺死巴庫暴龍！
我們要親手消滅這隻魔物！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It seems we would no longer be able to
hold rituals to calm Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
看來我們再也無法
舉行安撫巴庫暴龍的儀式了。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
年輕的占卜師正在尋求幫助，
她說月亮的能量似乎有些異常。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Young Fortune Teller is looking for your help
saying that the energy of the moon seems strange.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
年輕的占卜師正在尋求幫助，
她說月亮的能量似乎有些異常。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I know that terrible things happened
long time ago when the moon disappeared.
I hope the moon recovers its strength
with your devoted effort.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我知道很久以前月亮消失時，
發生過可怕的事情。
希望憑藉你的努力，
月亮能恢復它的光芒。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I will tell the
Young Fortune Teller to help you.
But before that, there is
something you must do immediately.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我會讓年輕的占卜師來幫助你。
但在那之前，
有一件事你必須立刻去做。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We never know when Bakonawa will attack
the village so we must set traps near the village
entrance and near the cave.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我們不知道巴庫暴龍何時會襲擊村莊，
所以必須在村口和洞穴附近設定陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
I would be grateful if you help us.
I have dispatched workers
near where traps will be set up,
so you just have to visit about 5 places.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
如果你能幫上忙，我將不勝感激。
我已經派工人在設定陷阱的地點附近等候，
你只需要去大約5個地方即可。

scripts.text: Sounds like too much work.
scripts.translation: 聽起來工作量太大了

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
This operation means life and death to us
yet you refuse it easily as if
it was some kind of a chore...
scripts.translation:
[村長]
這項行動關乎我們的生死存亡，
你卻像對待雜務一樣輕易拒絕...

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
What a hero!
scripts.translation:
[村長]
真是位英雄！

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第一個陷阱將設定在巴里奧·馬希瓦加草原，
靠近村口的地方。^0000FF粗聲粗氣的工人^000000
會在那裡等你。他會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The first trap will be set up at
Baryo Mahiwaga Field
near the village entrance. ^0000FFGruffy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第一個陷阱將設定在巴里奧·馬希瓦加草原，
靠近村口的地方。^0000FF粗聲粗氣的工人^000000
會在那裡等你。他會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The second trap will be set up
near a place where it connects from
Baryo Mahiwaga Field to Bakonawa Lake.
^0000FFGrumpy Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第二個陷阱將設定在巴里奧·馬希瓦加草原
通往食月暴龍湖的交界處附近。
^0000FF脾氣暴躁的工人^000000
會在那裡等你。他會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The third trap will be set up
near Bakonawa Lake Entrance.
^0000FFCowardly Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第三個陷阱將設定在食月暴龍湖入口附近。
^0000FF膽小的工人^000000
會在那裡等你。他會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fourth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake as well.
^0000FFGloomy Worker^000000 will be waiting for you.
He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第四個陷阱也將設定在食月暴龍湖入口附近。
^0000FF陰鬱的工人^000000會在那裡等你。
他會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
The fifth trap will be set up
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake too.
^0000FFSentimental Worker^000000
will be waiting for you. He will be very helpful.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
第五個陷阱也將設定在食月暴龍湖入口附近。
^0000FF多愁善感的工人^000000
會在那裡等你。他會很有幫助。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
It looks like the traps are all set up.
We just finished our village meeting on
what to do about Bakonawa.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
看起來陷阱都已經佈置好了。
我們剛剛結束了關於如何應對巴庫暴龍的村民會議。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
We have concluded that
we will fight against Bakonawa.
Please help us by
attacking his lair.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
我們決定要對抗巴庫暴龍。
請協助我們，去攻擊它的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Would you visit ^0000FFOld Legend Teller^000000
when you have a chance?
I think you would be able to help him.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
如果您有空的話，
請去拜訪一下^0000FF古老傳說的講述者^000000。
我想您應該能幫到他。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
請為了那些無數的受害者，
擊敗巴庫暴龍。

scripts.text:
[Village Chief]
Thank you.
Please think of the countless victims
and defeat Bakonawa
for their sake.
scripts.translation:
[村長]
謝謝您。
請為了那些無數的受害者，
擊敗巴庫暴龍。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
Please find our
child.
Bakonawa would have not harmed our child.
He must be around here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
請找到我們的孩子。
巴庫暴龍不會傷害我們的孩子。
他一定就在附近某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
You are looking for two of his ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000?
Are you confident that
he already died?
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
您是在尋找他的兩件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000嗎？
您確信他已經死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
This... is our child's ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
for sure.
The monster got to him after all....
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
這...這肯定是我家孩子的^FF0000丟失的物品^000000。
終究還是被魔物給襲擊了...

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Let's retrieve them from Tiyanak that roams Baryo Mahiwaga Field,
seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子試圖忍住淚水，卻無法繼續說下去。
讓我們繼續尋找失蹤者的丟失物品。
從徘徊在巴里奧·馬希瓦加草原的惡魔嬰兒身上，
收集七件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並交給^0000FF失蹤者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
我的孩子...我可憐的孩子...

scripts.text:
The man is unable to continue as he tries to hold back his tears.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Friend^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子試圖忍住淚水，卻無法繼續說下去。
讓我們繼續尋找失蹤者的丟失物品。
從惡魔嬰兒身上收集七件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並交給^0000FF失蹤者的朋友^000000。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Father]
My baby... my poor baby...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的父親]
我的孩子...我可憐的孩子...

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Please find
my friend.
We were playing ball together
and suddenly my friend disappeared.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
請找到我的朋友。
我們本來在一起玩球，
突然之間我的朋友就消失了。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
I'm sure he is alive and well
somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
我相信他一定還活著，
就在某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
You are looking for seven ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend?
My friend is not dead!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
您是在尋找我朋友的七件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000嗎？
我的朋友沒有死！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
These are marbles and toys I gave him...
These are clearly ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my friend... Where is my friend?
Bring him here, bring him here now!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
這些是我給他的彈珠和玩具...
這些明顯是我朋友的^FF0000丟失的物品^000000...我的朋友在哪裡？
把他帶回來，現在就把他帶回來！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Friend]
Bring back my friend!
Bring back my friend now!
My friend is alive,
It's all a lie, sob~
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的朋友]
把我的朋友帶回來！
現在就把他帶回來！
我的朋友還活著，
這都是謊言，嗚嗚~

scripts.text:
Leaving behind the crying boy,
let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Son^000000.
scripts.translation:
留下哭泣的男孩，
讓我們繼續尋找失蹤者的丟失物品。
從惡魔嬰兒身上收集三件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並交給^0000FF失蹤者的兒子^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Bakonawa has hurt my father?
I can't believe this.
Please find my father!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
巴庫暴龍傷害了我的父親？
我無法相信這件事。
請找到我的父親！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
You are looking for three ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000
of my father? Why lost belongings and not my father?
No, that can't be it. He is alive somewhere!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
您是在尋找我父親的三件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000嗎？為什麼是丟失的物品，而不是我父親？
不，不可能。他一定還活著，在某個地方！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
These are clearly his clothes and shoes...
These are ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my father.
Oh dear lord... father!
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
這些明顯是他的衣服和長靴...
這些是我父親的^FF0000丟失的物品^000000。
天哪...父親！

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Son]
Why did such a thing happen....
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的兒子]
為什麼...會發生這種事...

scripts.text:
Man crying in agony.
Let's continue to find the lost belongings of the missing people.
Retrieve five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 from Tiyanak
and deliver them to ^0000FFMissing Person's Mother^000000.
scripts.translation:
男子悲痛欲絕。
讓我們繼續尋找失蹤者的丟失物品。
從惡魔嬰兒身上收集五件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000，
並交給^0000FF失蹤者的母親^000000。

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Please find my child.
I sent her out to do a chore
and she still isn't back.
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
請幫我找到我的孩子。
我讓她出門做點家務，
但她到現在還沒回來。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
You are looking for five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
What does this mean?
Are you saying my child is dead?
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
你是在尋找我孩子的五件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000嗎？
這是什麼意思？
你是說我孩子已經死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
This is my child's hair comb.
Why do you have five ^FF0000Lost Belongings^000000 of my child?
Why...? She's... dead?
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
這是我孩子的髮梳。
為什麼你會有我孩子的五件^FF0000丟失的物品^000000？
為什麼...？她...死了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
No wait... I think I hear her voice.
She's going to be home soon. I should go home now.
I should prepare a dinner for her. She must be starving.
Ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
不，等等...我好像聽到了她的聲音。
她馬上就要回家了。我該回家了。
我應該為她準備晚餐。她一定餓壞了。
哈哈...

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已經瘋掉母親...
既然我已經找到了失蹤者，
我應該向村長彙報。

scripts.text:
[Missing Person's Mother]
Ha ha ha... I can hear my child's voice,
just listen closely.
Can't you hear her calling her mother?
Ha ha ha...
scripts.translation:
[失蹤者的母親]
哈哈哈...我能聽到我孩子的聲音，
請仔細聽。
你難道聽不到她在呼喚母親嗎？
哈哈哈...

scripts.text:
A mother that has gone mad...
Now that I finished finding the missing people,
I should report back to the Village Chief.
scripts.translation:
一位已經瘋掉母親...
既然我已經找到了失蹤者，
我應該向村長彙報。

scripts.text: A mother that has gone mad...
scripts.translation: 一位已經瘋掉母親...

scripts.text: You cannot start the conversation. You are carrying too many items. -
scripts.translation: 無法開始對話。你攜帶的物品太多了。-

scripts.text: - He seems cautious of you. -
scripts.translation: - 他似乎對你很警惕。 -

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims,
is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
月亮的能量變弱了。
魔物變多，
受害者變多，
這都是因為月亮能量減弱。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
The energy of the moon grew weak for a couple of days.
The reason there are more monsters,
and the reason there are more victims, is all because of this.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
月亮的能量已經減弱了好幾天了。
魔物變多，
受害者變多，
這都是因為月亮能量減弱。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I'm trying to hold a ritual
that will restore the moon's energy by sacrificing monsters' blood,
so I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
我正在舉行一個儀式，
通過獻祭魔物的血液來恢復月亮的能量，
所以你需要在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原獵殺十五隻^FF0000邪魔馬^000000。

scripts.text: It's none of my business.
scripts.translation: 這不關我的事。

scripts.text: You can count on me.
scripts.translation: 包在我身上。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
You are so selfish!
During the ritual,
I will pray for your bad luck too.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
你太自私了！
在儀式期間，
我也會為你祈禱，讓你擺脫厄運。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
快一點。
如果月亮完全消失，
將會發生大災難。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
It looks like you took care of ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
well enough.
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
看來你已經很好地處理了^FF0000邪魔馬^000000。
我想現在可以開始儀式了。
我們需要一些物品，請去村長那裡尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I need you to hunt fifteen ^FF0000Tikbalang^000000
at Baryo Mahiwaga Field.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
你需要在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原獵殺十五隻^FF0000邪魔馬^000000。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
Hurry.
If the moon completely disappears,
there will be a great disaster.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
快一點。
如果月亮完全消失，
將會發生大災難。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
I think I can start the ritual now.
There are some items that we need, please go to
the Village Chief for help.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
我想現在可以開始儀式了。
我們需要一些物品，請去村長那裡尋求幫助。

scripts.text:
[Young Fortune Teller]
On the day when the moon fully disappears,
the dragon will attack the village.
No one will be safe.
scripts.translation:
[年輕的占卜師]
在月亮完全消失的那一天，
龍會襲擊村莊。
沒有人能倖免。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
村長讓我在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
The trap will be set right in front.
Walk forward a little.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
陷阱就設在前面。
往前走一點。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
脾氣暴躁的工人在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原與食月暴龍湖的交界處附近。
去那裡和他一起佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Are you trying to advertise that
there is a trap here? Step aside.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
你是在這裡打廣告說這裡有陷阱嗎？讓開。

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我應該就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
Using the tools like this
bang bang bang!
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
像這樣使用工具
叮叮噹噹！

scripts.text: bang bang bang!
scripts.translation: 叮叮噹噹！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go and set up the trap together.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
脾氣暴躁的工人在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原與食月暴龍湖的交界處附近。
去那裡和他一起佈置陷阱。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經在這裡佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
This trap is not meant to capture you,
so move.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
這個陷阱不是用來抓你的，
快讓開。

scripts.text:
[Gruffy Worker]
You can find the
Grumpy Worker near where
Baryo Mahiwaga Field connects to Bakonawa Lake.
Go there to him.
scripts.translation:
[粗聲粗氣的工人]
脾氣暴躁的工人在巴里奧·馬希瓦加平原與食月暴龍湖的交界處附近。
去那裡找他。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Sooo boring!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
村長讓我在這裡等你。
好...無聊啊！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
A hole needs to be dug up in front of here?
I have to dig too?
Says who?
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
要在前面挖個洞？
我也得挖？
誰說的？

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
去食月暴龍湖入口附近找膽小的工人。
快點，動起來！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I set up the trap
and you are advertising that it's here.
Scram!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
我佈置了陷阱，
你卻在這裡打廣告說這裡有陷阱。
滾開！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我應該就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
I really don't like it here!
...
With this pickax,
dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
我真的很討厭這裡！
...
用這個鎬子，
挖挖挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖挖挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
去食月暴龍湖入口附近找膽小的工人。
快點，動起來！

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經在這裡佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Are you trying to test
with your body if the trap works?
Move aside!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
你是在用身體測試陷阱是否有效嗎？
讓開！

scripts.text:
[Grumpy Worker]
Go find the Cowardly Worker
near the entrance of Bakonawa Lake.
Come on, move it!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣暴躁的工人]
去食月暴龍湖入口附近找膽小的工人。
快點，動起來！

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Village Chief told me to
wait for you here.
Why me? I have a bad feeling about this....
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
村長讓我在這裡等你。
為什麼是我？我對這件事有種不好的預感....

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
set up a trap in front of here?
Village Chief said I have to help too?
Can you please do it by yourself?
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
要在前面佈置陷阱？
村長說我也得幫忙？
你能不能自己搞定？

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
Go! You scare me.
You look like you are going to beat me up.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
往上走就能找到陰鬱的工人。
快去吧！你嚇到我了。
你看起來像是要揍我一樣。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go away!
What if Bakonawa
appears because of you?
I'm scared to death!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
快走開！
萬一因為你引來了巴庫暴龍怎麼辦？
我嚇死了！

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我應該就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
There is nothing weird
buried here right?
...
Using the shovel, dig dig dig!
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
這裡沒有埋什麼奇怪的東西吧？
...
用鏟子，挖挖挖！

scripts.text: dig dig dig!
scripts.translation: 挖挖挖！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
往上走就能找到陰鬱的工人。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經在這裡佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Step aside immediately!
Bakonawa might find out this is a trap
and come for us.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
馬上讓開！
巴庫暴龍可能會發現這是個陷阱，然後衝過來找我們。

scripts.text:
[Cowardly Worker]
Go up and you will
find the Gloomy Worker.
scripts.translation:
[膽小的工人]
往上走就能找到陰鬱的工人。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
He must want me to do something.
Whew...
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
村長讓我在這裡等你。
他肯定是有什麼事要我做。
呼...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
set up a trap on the left side?
I don't think it will be much use...
Whew, I should've moved away or something...
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
要在左邊佈置陷阱？
我覺得這沒什麼用...
呼，我早該搬走才對...

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
We are all gonna die anyway by Bakonawa.
This is pointless.
Just go up the path and you will find
Sentimental Worker.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
反正最後都會被巴庫暴龍殺死。
做這些毫無意義。
沿著路往上走就能找到多愁善感的工人。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Bakonawa is going to attack us anyway.
What pointless work...
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
反正巴庫暴龍都會攻擊我們。
真是白費力氣...

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我應該就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Just catch this net,
throw throw!
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
拿著這張網，
扔扔扔！

scripts.text: throw throw!
scripts.translation: 扔扔扔！

scripts.text: The trap is now set.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
Just go up the path and you will find
Sentimental Worker.
Though I doubt it will be much help.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
沿著路往上走就能找到多愁善感的工人。
不過我覺得他也沒什麼幫助。

scripts.text: The trap has been set up here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱已經在這裡佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Gloomy Worker]
The trap is meaningless.
See? It doesn't even work.
scripts.translation:
[陰鬱的工人]
這陷阱毫無意義。
看吧，它甚至不起作用。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Village Chief told me to wait for you here.
Is there a some kind of surprise event?
My heart is beating faster~
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
村長讓我在這裡等你。
是不是有什麼驚喜活動？
我的心跳得好快~

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Wow! So we are going to work together
to set up a trap behind this place?
This is sooo cool!
This is the coolest thing in the world!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
哇！我們要一起在這裡後面佈置陷阱嗎？
這也太酷了！
這是世界上最酷的事情！

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Now that the trap is set,
Are we going to report back to Village Chief?
Oh what fun!
It sounds so exiting!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
陷阱佈置好了，
我們要去回報村長嗎？
太有趣了！
聽起來好激動人心！

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
More I think about it, more exited I get.
I'm secretly guarding the trap!
I want to hear out loud.
I have a trap in front of me! Ha ha ha ha~
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
越想越激動。
我正在秘密守護著陷阱！
我想大聲說出來。
我面前有一個陷阱！哈哈哈哈~

scripts.text:
I should set up the trap
right about here.
scripts.translation: 我應該就在這裡佈置陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Wow! This really is a perfect place
to set up a trap.
I'm going to throw the rope!
Here goes the rope!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
哇！這裡真的是佈置陷阱的完美地點。
我要扔繩子了！
繩子飛出去！

scripts.text: Here goes the rope!
scripts.translation: 繩子飛出去！

scripts.text:
The trap is now set.
Let's go to the Village Chief
now that the trap is set.
scripts.translation:
陷阱已經佈置好了。
既然陷阱設好了，
我們去見村長吧。

scripts.text: The trap is set here.
scripts.translation: 陷阱在這裡佈置好了。

scripts.text:
[Sentimental Worker]
Try out the trap first!
I'm so curious
what would happen!
It's going to be so much fun!
scripts.translation:
[多愁善感的工人]
先試試陷阱吧！
我很好奇
會發生什麼！
一定很有趣！

scripts.text: Seafood and Black Bean Sauce Noodle!
scripts.translation: 海鮮黑豆醬麵！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Just boldly tell me
what is it that you want!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱計劃]
大膽地告訴我，
你想要什麼！

scripts.text: Reset all quests
scripts.translation: 重置所有任務

scripts.text: Just before the end of first quest
scripts.translation: 第一個任務結束前

scripts.text: Reset secondary quest
scripts.translation: 重置次要任務

scripts.text: Distribution of lost belongings
scripts.translation: 分發丟失的物品

scripts.text: Just after hunting
scripts.translation: 狩獵結束後

scripts.text: Here you go!
scripts.translation: 給你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱計劃]
給你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱計劃]
給你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱計劃]
給你！

scripts.text:
[Briquet Scheme]
Here you go!
scripts.translation:
[布里凱計劃]
給你！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman?
I think you should search for something else.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
護身符？
我覺得你應該找找別的東西。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A talisman and a person?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
護身符和一個人？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I did see the talisman but I didn't go near it because I got a bad feeling about it.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我確實看到了那個護身符，但我沒有靠近，因為我對它有種不好的預感。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the village?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哦！
說到護身符，那位老婦人應該很瞭解，因為她把一些護身符掛在了村莊周圍。
我覺得去問問她是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
Speaking of talismans, wouldn't that old lady know about them, since she put some around the hospital?
I think it'll be a good idea to ask her.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哦！
說到護身符，那位老婦人應該很瞭解，因為她把一些護身符掛在了醫院周圍。
我覺得去問問她是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
A shaman... Best if we met her.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
薩滿...最好能去見見她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh!
You must have met her.
I feel something strong...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哦！
你一定已經見過她了。
我感覺到一股強烈的力量...

scripts.text: Tell her about the talisman.
scripts.translation: 告訴她關於護身符的事

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
是的！
我有個主意。
我們要不要把它貼在我們之前在二樓門上看到的那個上面？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
也許這樣能阻擋它散發出的邪惡能量。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes!
I have an idea.
How about we stick that one over the one we saw on the 2nd floor door?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
是的！
我有個主意。
我們要不要把它貼在我們之前在二樓門上看到的那個上面？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe it will block the bad energy it's giving out.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
也許這樣能阻擋它散發出的邪惡能量。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
*Sigh*...
I thought it strange when you were standing behind me....
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
*嘆氣*...
剛才你站在我身後的時候，我就覺得有點奇怪....

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
I didn't think you'd do something like this.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
沒想到你會做出這種事。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
We were just about to enter Bangungot's room, before we were thrown out...
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
我們本來正要進入噩夢死神般滾勾特的房間，結果卻被趕了出來...

scripts.text: Bangungot?
scripts.translation: 噩夢死神般滾勾特？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne?
scripts.translation: 護士 梅恩？

scripts.text: Nurse Maenne
scripts.translation: 護士 梅恩

scripts.text: Bangungot
scripts.translation: 噩夢死神般滾勾特

scripts.text: Enter the hospital.
scripts.translation: 進入醫院

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
嗯...

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You have too many items. -
- Cannot receive item. -
- Please lighten your bag -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您的物品欄已滿。 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請整理背包 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text:
- Wait !! -
- You are carrying too many items. -
- Cannot receive item. -
- Please lighten your bag -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您攜帶的物品過多。 -
- 無法接收物品。 -
- 請整理背包 -
- 然後重試。 -

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Tsk...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
嘖...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It's a vicious monster roaming this hospital.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
那是一隻在這家醫院遊蕩的兇惡魔物。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Hmmmm...
It's not exactly a monster....
More like a curse or disease...
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
嗯...
它其實不完全是魔物...
更像是一種詛咒或疾病...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
There's a story saying that it used to be a wood fairy.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
傳說它曾經是一個森林妖精。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Anyway, it doesnt change the fact that she killed the patients of this hospital and turned them into monsters.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
總之，這並不改變她殺害了這家醫院的病人並將他們變成魔物這一事實。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Me?
As you can see, I'm the new nurse here.
I'm a nurse who specializes in 'this' kind of work, instead of looking after patients.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
我嗎？
如您所見，我是這裡的新護士。
我專門負責處理“這類”工作，而不是照顧病人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Oh!
The Bangungot pretended to be me?
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
哦！
噩夢死神般滾勾特偽裝成了我？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Seeing how much it rattled you.
It's a rather smart one.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
看它把你嚇得夠嗆的樣子。
它還挺聰明的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Simply said, I cure unnatural phenomenon around hospitals.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
簡單來說，我負責治療醫院周圍的異常現象。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Many things happen in the world.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
這個世界上會發生很多事情。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
She may have rooted here deeper than I thought.
I can still feel her presence.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
她在這裡紮根比我想像的更深。
我依然能感覺到她的存在。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
What you killed was a part of her...
But, it was a big help since you confused and damaged her at the same time.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
你殺死的只是她的一部分...
不過，這幫了大忙，因為你同時擾亂並傷害了她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It makes things a lot easier.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
這讓事情變得容易多了。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
It would've been easier if she was apart from her body, but now that she returned to her room, this is going to be a little tricky.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
如果她不在身體裡，事情會更容易些，但現在她回到了房間，這就有點棘手了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
Of course, don't you dare walk away from this, since you disturbed my job and led her to her room.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
當然，你絕對不可以就這樣走開，畢竟是你打擾了我的工作，還把她引到了房間。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Maenne]
If you make it to the 2nd floor door, I'll open a small door to her room for you.
After that, she's all yours.
scripts.translation:
[護士 梅恩]
如果你能到達二樓的門口，我會為你開啟通往她房間的小門。
之後，就交給你了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
People of this town are too cautious of outsiders.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
這個城鎮的人對外來者太警惕了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'm sure they have their reasons, but I wish they'd tell me how to get closer...
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我相信他們有自己的理由，但我希望他們能告訴我如何拉近關係...

scripts.text:
There's a nurse outside the hospital holding a large bag.
I don't think I can help her.
scripts.translation:
醫院外站著一位護士，手裡提著一個大袋子。
我覺得我幫不了她。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Hey, hold on.
Are you planning on going inside?
scripts.translation:
[護士]
嘿，等一下。
你打算進去嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Oh~
I'm so glad!
I was literally waiting all day for someone to some by.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
哦~
太好了！
我簡直等了一整天，終於有人來了。

scripts.text: About the hospital
scripts.translation: 關於醫院

scripts.text: Reason for stalling me
scripts.translation: 攔我的原因

scripts.text: Ignore.
scripts.translation: 無視

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
This hospital is the only one in town.
And it's going to be my new job.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
這家醫院是鎮上唯一的醫院。
而且，這裡將成為我的新工作場所。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I heard it was just built, but it seems so creepy....
scripts.translation:
[護士]
聽說它是剛建好的，但看起來好詭異....

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was surprised when I got here too.
It says 'closed' all around it!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我來的時候也很驚訝。
周圍都貼著“停業”！

scripts.text: Reason for stalling me.
scripts.translation: 攔我的原因

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was told that they needed nurses in this town,
so I came here after turning down numerous proposals.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
聽說這個城鎮需要護士，
所以我拒絕了無數其他提議，來到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'd heard they were really cautious of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我聽說他們對外來者非常警惕...

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Not even a soul to welcome me, let alone a party!
Shocking!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
連一個歡迎我的人都沒有，更別提舉辦歡迎會了！
太令人震驚了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
What's more, I made it here after being lost and now I'm facing a creepy and locked hospital!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
更糟糕的是，我迷路才好不容易來到這裡，結果面對的卻是一座陰森森的、上了鎖的醫院！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was told that they needed nurses in this town,
so I came here after turning down numerous proposals.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
聽說這個城鎮需要護士，
所以我拒絕了無數其他提議，來到了這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I'd heard they were really cautious of outsiders...
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我聽說他們對外來者非常警惕...

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Not even a soul to welcome me, let alone a party!
Shocking!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
連一個歡迎我的人都沒有，更別提舉辦歡迎會了！
太令人震驚了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
What's more, I made it here after being lost and now I'm facing a creepy and locked hospital!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
更糟糕的是，我迷路才好不容易來到這裡，結果面對的卻是一座陰森森的、上了鎖的醫院！

scripts.text: About the hospital
scripts.translation: 關於醫院

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
This hospital is the only one in town.
And it's going to be my new job.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
這家醫院是鎮上唯一的醫院。
而且，這裡將成為我的新工作場所。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I heard it was just built, but it seems so creepy....
scripts.translation:
[護士]
聽說它是剛建好的，但看起來好詭異....

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I was surprised when I got here too.
It says 'closed' all around it!
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我來的時候也很驚訝。
周圍都貼著“停業”！

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Yes, you must be busy.
Oh, well.
I'll let you be on your way.
Don't mind me. *Sob*
scripts.translation:
[護士]
是的，您一定很忙。
算了。
我就不打擾您了。
請別在意我。*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Oh, I see...
scripts.translation:
[護士]
哦，我明白了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Now that you say it... If you're going inside, could you take me with you?
scripts.translation:
[護士]
您這麼一說...如果您要進去的話，能帶上我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Doors are locked!
My bags are heavy!
And my legs are killing me.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
門都鎖著！
我的行李好重！
而且我的腿快斷了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
If I knew this was going to happen, I would've worn ER night-shift shoes instead of first-day shoes... *sniff*
scripts.translation:
[護士]
如果早知道會這樣，我當初就該穿急診夜班的長靴，而不是第一天上班穿的鞋...*吸鼻子*

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 幫忙

scripts.text: Don't help.
scripts.translation: 不幫忙

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
*Sob*
I guess this world is still worth living in.
You are too kind.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
*抽泣*
看來這個世界還是值得活下去的。
您真是太好了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'm 'Las', who's supposed to work in this hospital.
By the looks of it, though, I may become jobless...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我是“拉斯”，本該在這家醫院工作。
不過看這情況，我可能要失業了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Let's start by getting inside.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
首先，我們得想辦法進去。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Before that....
Could you get something to wrap my feet? I can't put my shoes on because I've got blisters.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
在那之前...
能幫我找點東西裹一下腳嗎？我腳上磨出了水泡，穿不了鞋。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
2 Rotten Bandages should do to wrap both my feet. They may look dirty, but they have special liquid on them that have amazing effects.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
兩條腐爛繃帶應該就夠裹住雙腳了。雖然看起來很髒，但上面塗有特殊液體，效果驚人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
Yes, you must be busy.
Oh, well.
I'll let you be on your way.
Don't mind me. *Sob*
scripts.translation:
[護士]
是的，您一定很忙。
算了。
我就不打擾您了。
請別在意我。*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh......
I know they're effective but... Not so tempting.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哦......
我知道它們很有效，但是...看起來不太誘人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Rotten Bandages... A fit name for something that seems to have been cut fresh from a mummy.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
腐爛繃帶...這名字真貼切，看起來就像剛從木乃伊身上撕下來的。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'm having second thoughts looking at them, but as I am to be a professional nurse!!
Here goes nothing!!!
Ewwww!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
看著它們我有點猶豫，但我可是專業的護士！！
豁出去了！！！
嘔！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Squish*
*Squelch*
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
*噗嘰*
*咕嘰*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Before that...
Could you get something to wrap my feet? I can't put my shoes on because I've got blisters.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
在那之前...
能幫我找點東西裹一下腳嗎？我腳上磨出了水泡，穿不了鞋。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
2 Rotten Bandages should do to wrap both my feet. They may look dirty, but they have special liquid on that have with amazing effects.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
兩條腐爛繃帶應該就夠裹住雙腳了。雖然看起來很髒，但上面塗有特殊液體，效果驚人。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Ahhhhh...
My feet feel a lot better now, but it smells funny.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
啊......
腳感覺好多了，但是味道有點怪。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh...... the smell......
My new shoes will be ruined...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哦......這味道......
我的新鞋要遭殃了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay!!!!!!
I don't know if it's locked or stuck, let's try pushing it together!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
好！！！！
不知道是鎖住了還是卡住了，我們一起推吧！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay!!!!!!
I don't know if it's locked or stuck, let's try pushing it together!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
好！！！！
不知道是鎖住了還是卡住了，我們一起推吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
We pushed and pulled, but it won't budge.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我們推也推不動，拉也拉不開。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Strange~
They wouldn't have sent me to a closed down hospital.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
奇怪~
總部不會派我來一家已經關閉的醫院。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hmmm!
I can't stand it anymore!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哼！
我受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Could you ask the townsfolk about the hospital while I contact HQ?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我去聯絡總部，你能問問鎮上的人關於這家醫院的事嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey, why don't you start with that girl over there?
Perhaps she'll tell you something.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
嘿，你不妨先問問那邊那個女孩？
也許她會告訴你些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
What did she say?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
她說了什麼？

scripts.text: Tell her what she said.
scripts.translation: 告訴她女孩說了什麼

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Strange.
HQ confirmed that I am assigned here.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
奇怪。
總部確認了我的派遣任務就是這裡。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Maybe that girl doesn't know about this place?
HQ couldn't have sent me here and be lying about it. Could you ask someone else in town?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
也許那個女孩不知道這個地方？
總部不會無緣無故派我來這裡還撒謊。你能問問鎮上其他人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'll contact HQ again for more info.
Hey, why not ask that man over there?
I'm sure he'll know something.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我再聯絡總部問問詳情。
嘿，你不妨問問那邊那個男子？
他肯定知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I'll contact HQ again for more info.
Hey, why not ask that man over there?
I'm sure he'll know something.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我再聯絡總部問問詳情。
嘿，你不妨問問那邊那個男子？
他肯定知道些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
An inn?
Good gracious!
If they'd have told me earlier I wouldn't have had to stand out here for so long!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
旅館？
天哪！
要是早點告訴我，我就不必在外面站這麼久了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey... you know what...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
嘿...你知道嗎...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I don't think I can move anymore because of my feet. Could you go to the inn for me?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我的腳好像動不了了。你能替我去一趟旅館嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I can't carry my bags around so I'll stay here and watch over them while I treat my feet.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
我搬不動這些行李，所以我會留在這裡看著它們，順便處理一下我的腳。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
I have to be back here again anyway.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
反正我最後還得回到這裡。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:

Thank you.
