反正我最後還得回到這裡。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey~
How'd it go?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
嘿~
怎麼樣了？

scripts.text: Hand over the key and message.
scripts.translation: 交出鑰匙和留言

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Keys?
Well this is one step closer to my goals!
Let's open the door right now!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
鑰匙？
這下離我的目標又近了一步！
我們現在就開門吧！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Keys?
Well this is one step closer to my goals!
Let's open the door right now!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
鑰匙？
這下離我的目標又近了一步！
我們現在就開門吧！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
That's weird~!
The door's not locked?
How can this be?????
????
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
這不對勁~！
門沒鎖？
怎麼會這樣？？？？？
？？？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh no!!!
Everything's falling apart.
Maybe we should wait for the doctor to come.....
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
糟糕！！！
一切都要崩塌了。
也許我們應該等醫生來...

scripts.text:
[???]
*Snigger*

[???]
Hey {0},
You're not getting in the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[???]
嘿 {0}，
你不能進醫院。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who's there?!

[???]
*Snigger*

[???]
That's a secret~
My mom will kill me if she knew I was here!
scripts.translation:
[???]
這是個秘密~
如果我媽媽知道我在這裡，她會殺了我的！

scripts.text: About entering the hospital.
scripts.translation: 關於進入醫院的事

scripts.text: About it's mom.
scripts.translation: 關於她媽媽的事

scripts.text: About ???
scripts.translation: 關於???

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[???]
A few days ago, the old lady who lives near us went around the hospital sticking some kind of sticks into the ground.
scripts.translation:
[???]
幾天前，住在我們附近的老婦人一直在醫院周圍轉悠，把某種棍子插進地裡。

scripts.text:
[???]
She was mumbling and looking around a lot.
scripts.translation:
[???]
她一直在嘟囔著，四處張望。

scripts.text:
[???]
I was well hidden here because I wasn't supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我躲在這裡，因為我不應該出現在這裡。

scripts.text:
[???]
My mom once told me.
The old lady's daughter was hospitalized here.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我媽媽曾告訴我。
那位老婦人的女兒曾在這裡住院。

scripts.text:
[???]
She never got out of it though...
scripts.translation:
[???]
但她再也沒有出來過...

scripts.text:
[???]
She wasn't the only one. There were many strange things going on at the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[???]
不止她一個人。醫院裡發生了很多奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[???]
That's why my mom doesn't want me coming around here.
scripts.translation:
[???]
所以我媽媽不讓我來這裡。

scripts.text:
[???]
No way Jose!
I got a spanking last time I was caught around here!
scripts.translation:
[???]
絕對不行！
上次我偷偷來這裡被抓到，被狠狠打了一頓！

scripts.text:
[???]
If I'm caught again, it won't end with a spanking....
So scary.
scripts.translation:
[???]
如果再次被抓到，後果就不止是一頓打那麼簡單了....
好可怕。

scripts.text:
[???]
Humph!!
The voice seems to be coming from the bushes near the entrance of the hospital.
scripts.translation: 聲音似乎來自醫院入口附近的灌木叢。

scripts.text:
The voice seems to be coming from the bushes near the entrance of the hospital.
Let's check around.
scripts.translation:
聲音似乎來自醫院入口附近的灌木叢。
讓我們去檢視一下。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hmmm... Let's look around the hospital.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
嗯... 讓我們在醫院周圍看看吧。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey... ummm...
You know...
Could you give that old lady a visit?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
那個... 呃...
你知道嗎...
你能去探望一下那位老婦人嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh, me? I'll look be looking around here.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
哦，我嗎？我就在這裡附近轉轉。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
As you know, my feet hurt...
Yes?
Yes?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
你也知道，我的腳很疼...
是嗎？
是嗎？

scripts.text: Go.
scripts.translation: 出發。

scripts.text: Don't go.
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay, off you go.
I think she lives on the west side of town.
Go on.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
好了，去吧。
我想她住在城鎮的西邊。
快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey you in the bushes, I'll tell on you if you don't go home now!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
躲在灌木叢裡的你，再不回家我就告發你了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Why!?
Staying here won't solve anything.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
為什麼？
留在這裡解決不了任何問題。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Okay, off you go.
I think she lives on the west side of town.
Go on.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
好了，去吧。
我想她住在城鎮的西邊。
快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Hey you in the bushes, I'll tell on you if you don't go home now!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
躲在灌木叢裡的你，再不回家我就告發你了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
How'd it go?
Did you meet the old lady?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
怎麼樣了？
見到那位老婦人了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Oh by the way, when [{0}], you were gone, I tried the door.
It did open...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
對了，在你離開的這段時間，[{0}]，我試了試那扇門。
它竟然開了...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
But the way to the 2nd floor was blocked.
I thought the door opening was a break through, but turns out it wasn't.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
但是通往二樓的路被堵住了。
我以為門開了是個突破，結果發現並不是。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Anyway, the first floor door is open, so let's go inside.
Everything would be meaningless if the second floor door is not opened.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
總之，一樓的門開了，我們進去吧。
如果二樓的門打不開，這一切就毫無意義了。

scripts.text:

Everything would be meaningless if the second floor door is not opened.
scripts.translation:

總之，一樓的門開了，我們進去吧。
如果二樓的門打不開，這一切就毫無意義了。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Could you check the 2nd floor door again in case I missed something?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
你能再檢查一下二樓的門嗎？以防我漏掉了什麼。

scripts.text:
There's a nurse outside the hospital holding a large bag.
I don't think I can help her.
scripts.translation:
醫院外站著一位護士，手裡提著一個大袋子。
我覺得我幫不了她。

scripts.text:
The hospital is infested with monsters, like the old lady said.
How could she have gone back and forth to the 2nd floor with her feet like that....
scripts.translation:
醫院裡到處都是魔物，就像老婦人所說的那樣。
她的腳那樣，怎麼可能在二樓之間來回走動....

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Could you check the 2nd floor door again in case I missed something?
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
你能再檢查一下二樓的門嗎？以防我漏掉了什麼。

scripts.text: Go outside.
scripts.translation: 出去

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Tsk...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
嘖...

scripts.text:
[Nurse]
I want to be left alone.
Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[護士]
我想一個人待著。
請離開。

scripts.text:
There's a talisman similar to the ones outside the hospital.
Let's look around for something else.
scripts.translation:
這裡有一張符咒，和醫院外面的那些很像。
讓我們找找其他東西。

scripts.text:
There's a talisman similar to the ones outside the hospital.
Let's look around for something else.
scripts.translation:
這裡有一張符咒，和醫院外面的那些很像。
讓我們找找其他東西。

scripts.text: After sticking on the talisman over the other one, the dark feeling lifted away, just like Las said.
scripts.translation: 把這張符咒貼在另一張上面後，那種陰暗的感覺消失了，正如拉斯所說。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Snigger*
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Yes, yes!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
是的，是的！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
The annoying talismans are gone!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
那些煩人的符咒不見了！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Giggle*
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
*咯咯笑*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
Human's are so dumb. You show them a pretty little helpless look and they fall for it.
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
人類真是一群笨蛋。只要擺出一副楚楚可憐的樣子，他們就會乖乖上當。

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
*Snigger*
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
For your work, I shall take you to my room...
Darn...
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
為了你的工作，我會帶你去我的房間...
該死...

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
......

[Nurse Las]
No no no!
You still have those annoying talismans!!!
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
不不不！
你身上還帶著那些煩人的符咒！！！

scripts.text:
[Nurse Las]
This is your lucky day!
*Snigger*
scripts.translation:
[護士 拉斯]
今天是你的幸運之日！
*竊笑*

scripts.text:
Cannot feel anything evil about the talisman.
Only the bitter taste of being fooled around Las remains...
scripts.translation:
感覺不到符咒上有任何邪惡的氣息。
只剩下被拉斯耍得團團轉的苦澀滋味...

scripts.text: No power can be felt.
scripts.translation: 感覺不到任何力量。

scripts.text:
Pushed hard on the door, but it won't open.
It doesn't feel like it's locked or stuck, but encased by a layer of something.
scripts.translation:
用力推門，但門紋絲不動。
感覺不是鎖住了或卡住了，而是被某種東西包裹住了。

scripts.text:
Pushed hard on the door, but it won't open.
It doesn't feel like it's locked or stuck, but encased by a layer of something.
scripts.translation:
用力推門，但門紋絲不動。
感覺不是鎖住了或卡住了，而是被某種東西包裹住了。

scripts.text:
Put the key inside the lock of the hospital door...
But it's not locked as expected.
scripts.translation:
把鑰匙插進醫院門的鎖孔裡...
但門並沒有像預期那樣被鎖住。

scripts.text: Then why is the door not opening?

scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
最後，也是最重要的，1個靈魂碎片，將強力魔物的能量注入紋身中。

scripts.text: What kind of Tattoo will you draw?
scripts.translation: 你會繪製哪種紋身？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can draw 3 kinds of Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我可以繪製3種紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Bangungot Agimat Tattoo for a powerful monster that comes from an old gigantic tree in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
般滾勾特守護紋身，對應來自馬來港古老巨樹中的強力魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo for a huge monster that can swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
食月者守護紋身，對應能吞下月亮的大型魔物。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Buwaya Agimat Tattoo for a giant alligator that kidnaps people.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
寶箱巨鱷守護紋身，對應綁架人類的巨型鱷魚人。

scripts.text: Where can I get the Spirit Pieces and Doll?
scripts.translation: 我在哪裡可以獲得靈魂碎片和玩偶？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
You can get these powerful items from Buwaya, Bangungot, and Bakonawa themselves but it won't be an easy task.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你可以直接從寶箱巨鱷、般滾勾特和食月者身上獲得這些強力物品，但這並不容易。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
This holy task isn't done every day. Tattoos are drawn only during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
這項神聖的任務並非每天都能進行。只有在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”期間才能繪製紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Which Tattoo's effect are you curious about?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你對哪種紋身的效果感到好奇？

scripts.text: Bangungot Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特守護紋身

scripts.text: Buwaya Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷守護紋身

scripts.text: Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 食月者守護紋身

scripts.text: I have no questions.
scripts.translation: 我沒有其他問題了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bangungot's Spirit, and 1 Bangungot Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
製作需要10個古代的咒符、1個般滾勾特靈魂碎片和1個般滾勾特玩偶

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Bangungot Agimat Tattoo holds the energy of an old gigantic tree in Port Malaya.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
般滾勾特守護紋身蘊含著馬來港古老巨樹中的能量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases the effect of healing others by 4% and healing from others by 7%.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
提升對他人的治療效果4%，並提升自身受到的治療效果7%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Buwaya's Spirit, and 1 Buwaya Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
製作需要10個古代的咒符、1個寶箱巨鱷靈魂碎片和1個寶箱巨鱷玩偶

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Buwaya Agimat Tattoo contains the energy from a giant alligator.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
寶箱巨鱷守護紋身蘊含著巨型鱷魚人的能量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases MATK by +7% and decreases Fixed Casting by 7%.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
提升魔法攻擊(MATK)7%，並降低固定施法時間7%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of Bakonawa's Spirit, and 1 Bakonawa Doll to create
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
製作需要10個古代的咒符、1個食月者靈魂碎片和1個食月者玩偶

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo holds the energy from a gigantic monster that can swallow the moon.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
食月者守護紋身蘊含著能吞下月亮的巨型魔物的能量。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Increases ATK by +7% and ASPD by 10%.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
提升物理攻擊(ATK)7%，並提升攻擊速度(ASPD)10%。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Looks like you've got all the answers. Hope you enjoy your journey.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
看來你已經得到所有答案了。祝你旅途愉快。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Do you have any questions about other Tattoo effects?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你還有其他關於紋身效果的問題嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The holy task of drawing Tattoos is only done during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'. Sorry but looks like the festival is not on.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
繪製紋身這項神聖的任務僅在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”期間進行。抱歉，目前節日並未舉行。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
You've come right on time during the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
你來得正是時候，現在正值“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
There is no time like during the holy '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000' to draw Tattoos.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
繪製紋身，沒有比神聖的“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”期間更好的時機了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The festival doesn't last long so I should start drawing. What Tattoo do you need?
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
節日時間不長，我該開始繪製了。
你需要什麼紋身？

scripts.text: I will think it over.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: Bangungot Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 般滾勾特守護紋身

scripts.text: Buwaya Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 寶箱巨鱷守護紋身

scripts.text: Bakonawa Agimat Tattoo
scripts.translation: 食月者守護紋身

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Hope you enjoy the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
祝您在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”玩得盡興。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I think you are short on materials.
Need 10 Ancient Grudges, 1 Piece of {0}'s Spirit, and 1 {1} Doll to create a ^EE1D11{2} Agimat Tattoo^000000.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
看來你的材料不足。
製作^EE1D11{2} Agimat 紋身^000000需要10個古代的咒符、1塊{0}的精靈，以及1個{1}玩偶。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The materials are full with holy energy. I'm sure we'll get a great Tattoo using these.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
這些材料充滿了神聖的能量。
我相信用這些材料一定能做出很棒的紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Please don't interrupt while I'm working on drawing a holy Tattoo if you want it to come out right.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
如果你希望紋身繪製成功，請在我工作時不要打斷我。

scripts.text: The Tattooist placed the Ancient Grudges around the workplace.
scripts.translation: 紋身師將古代的咒符擺放在工作臺上。

scripts.text: The Ancient Grudge lit up and tools starts to glow. He smiled satisfyingly at the glowing tools and materials.
scripts.translation: 古代的咒符亮了起來，工具也開始發光。他滿意地看著發光的工具和材料，露出了微笑。

scripts.text: And then {0} stared intensely at the doll as if to remember every detail of it in his head.
scripts.translation: 然後，{0} 盯著那個玩偶，彷彿要將其每一個細節都記在腦海中。

scripts.text: Aren't you going to start?
scripts.translation: 你還不開始嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Oh no, now you ruined it.
I cannot draw a Tattoo for someone like you who doesn't understand art. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
哎呀，這下全毀了。
我無法為像你這樣不懂藝術的人繪製紋身。你可以拿回剩下的材料。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 拿回了5個古代的咒符、1個{0}玩偶，以及1塊{1}的精靈。

scripts.text: Think he will melt the doll with his eyes?
scripts.translation: 難道他想用眼神把玩偶融化嗎？

scripts.text: He closed and opened his eyes slowly as if to memorize the doll in his head and then held up a glowing tool to start drawing.
scripts.translation: 他緩慢地閉上又睜開雙眼，彷彿在腦海中銘記玩偶的模樣，隨後舉起發光的工具開始繪製。

scripts.text: The {0} Tattoo was completed almost instantly.
scripts.translation: {0} 紋身幾乎瞬間就完成了。

scripts.text: But he kept on looking at each corner of the drawing as if he didn't like some of its details.
scripts.translation: 但他仍盯著圖案的每個角落，似乎對某些細節不太滿意。

scripts.text: Looks good to me.
scripts.translation: 我覺得看起來不錯

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
嘖！我說過不要打斷我！

scripts.text: The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 紋身師惱怒地撕碎了那張畫。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我沒法這樣繼續下去了。也許改天再來吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 拿回了5個古代的咒符、1個{0}玩偶，以及1塊{1}的精靈。

scripts.text: He looked at the drawing intensely for a long time and then nodded with a satisfied smile.
scripts.translation: 他盯著那張畫看了很久，最後滿意地點了點頭，露出了笑容。

scripts.text: Looks like he is satisfied with the {0} drawing.
scripts.translation: 看來他對{0}的圖案很滿意。

scripts.text: But now he is staring at the sky without doing anything else. What is he waiting for?
scripts.translation: 但現在他只是望著天空，什麼也沒做。他在等什麼？

scripts.text: When will it be done?
scripts.translation: 什麼時候能完成？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
嘖！我說過不要打斷我！

scripts.text: The Tattooist ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 紋身師惱怒地撕碎了那張畫。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I can't continue like this. Maybe another time. You can take back the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我沒法這樣繼續下去了。也許改天再來吧。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges, {0} Doll, and Piece of {1}'s Spirit.
scripts.translation: 拿回了5個古代的咒符、1個{0}玩偶，以及1塊{1}的精靈。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
.

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
. .
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
. .

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
. . .

[Tattooist]
. . . .

[Tattooist]
. . . . .

[Tattooist]
. . . . . .

[Tattooist]
. . . . . . .
The Tattooist's eyes started to shine after staring at the sky for awhile, then he broke the Piece of {0}'s Spirit with both his hands.
scripts.translation: 紋身師盯著天空看了一會兒，眼神開始發光，隨後他用雙手捏碎了{0}的精靈碎片。

scripts.text: The Piece of {0}'s Spirit is shattered into powder. The Tattooist's hands are glowing.
scripts.translation: {0}的精靈碎片碎成了粉末。紋身師的雙手正散發著光芒。

scripts.text: Why did you break the pieces...
scripts.translation: 你為什麼要捏碎那些碎片...

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ergh! I told you not to interrupt!
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
嘖！我說過不要打斷我！

scripts.text: The glowing light from his hands faded away. He starred at his hands for a while and then ripped up the drawing irritably.
scripts.translation: 他手上的光芒漸漸消退。他盯著自己的手看了一會兒，然後惱怒地撕碎了那張畫。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I was this close to completing a wonderful piece but you ruined it. Not in a good mood. You can take the remaining materials.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我本來馬上就要完成一件傑作了，結果被你毀了。我現在心情很糟。剩下的材料你可以拿回去。

scripts.text: Received back 5 Ancient Grudges and the doll.
scripts.translation: 收回了5個古代的咒符和那個玩偶。

scripts.text: He held up the powder in both hands and then blew it onto the drawing.
scripts.translation: 他雙手捧著粉末，然後將其吹到了那張畫上。

scripts.text: All Ancient Grudges started to burn and then the glowing light from the {0} drawing faded away.
scripts.translation: 所有的古代的咒符開始燃燒，隨後{0}圖案上的光芒也漸漸消失了。

scripts.text: Blinking light on top of the drawing.
scripts.translation: 畫作上方閃爍著光芒。

scripts.text: Light faded away and the {0} drawing is no longer the simple one it was before.
scripts.translation: 光芒漸漸消退，{0}的圖案不再像之前那樣簡單了。

scripts.text: The {0} drawing looks as if it is... alive.
scripts.translation: {0}的圖案看起來彷彿...活了過來。

scripts.text: The Tattooist is finally satisfied and is all smiles.
scripts.translation: 紋身師終於滿意了，臉上露出了笑容。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ha ha. It came out great.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
哈哈，效果很棒。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
I'm sorry you had to wait for a long time. But it was worth it cause I haven't created a Tattoo of this quality in a long time.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
抱歉讓您等了這麼久。不過很值得，我已經很久沒有做出過這種品質的紋身了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
The ^EE1D11{0} Agimat Tattoo^000000 you've waited for is now completed.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
您等待已久的^EE1D11{0} Agimat紋身^000000已經完成了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Hope you enjoy the '^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000'.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
祝您在“^7A96E0Pintados Festival^000000”玩得盡興。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I came from afar and dropped everything to come and enjoy the 'Pintados Festival'.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我從遠方趕來，放下了一切，只為來享受“Pintados Festival”。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I don't regret visiting but...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我不後悔這次旅行，但是...

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I don't like the Tattoo I got after all I've gone through to get it.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
經歷了這麼多才得到的紋身，我其實並不喜歡。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've looked at it in the light but I think the Tattooist made a mistake.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我在光線下仔細看過，我覺得紋身師搞錯了。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
This ruined my whole visit.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
這毀了我整個行程。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Tsk!
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘖！

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I heard of the 'Pintados Festival' and came all the way from Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我聽說“Pintados Festival”，特意從崑崙趕來。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Just in case you might think otherwise, this is a mask on my face and not a tattoo.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
別誤會，我臉上戴的是面具，不是紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Hey, hear me. This isn't the Tattoo I wanted.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
嘿，聽我說。這不是我想要的紋身。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I asked for a Bakonawa Tattoo but the more I look at it, this is Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我要的是巴庫暴龍紋身，但我越看越覺得，這是噩夢死神般滾勾特。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
No... you said that you wanted that one. Don't be so difficult.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
不...您明明說想要那個的。別這麼難纏。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
Don't you know that customer is king? Huh? Do you want a bad reputation?
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
你不知道顧客就是上帝嗎？哼？你想壞名聲嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ugh... Can't believe this.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
唉...真是難以置信。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ah... I can't work with customers like this.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
唉...面對這樣的顧客，我沒法繼續工作了。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
How many times do I have to tell you, you said you wanted a Bangungot.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
我都說了多少遍了，您明明說要紋噩夢死神般滾勾特的。

scripts.text:
[Tattooist]
Ouch, my throat... Shouting will get me nowhere.
scripts.translation:
[紋身師]
嘶...我的喉嚨...大喊大叫解決不了任何問題。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
They say the Pintados Festival will only be held for one week.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
聽說彩繪節只舉辦一週。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I came from Luoyang without knowing about the festival. Must be my lucky day.
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我從洛陽來，之前並不知道有節日。看來是我的幸運之日。

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚-噠-咚- 咚-噠-咚-

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
The Pintados Festival wouldn't be a festival without a drummer.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
沒有鼓手，彩繪節就不成其為節日了。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
Why don't you join?
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
你要不要加入？

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚-噠-咚- 咚-噠-咚-

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
The Pintados from Pintados Festival means painted in our language.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
彩繪節裡的“彩繪”在我們的語言裡就是“被畫”的意思。

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
So that is probably why we have people drawing special Tattoos during the festival.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
所以大概是因為這個原因，節日期間大家會紋上特殊的紋身。

scripts.text: ba-dum-DUM- ba-dum-DUM
scripts.translation: 咚-噠-咚- 咚-噠-咚-

scripts.text:
[Drumming Young Man]
I don't remember it accurately, but they say the Pintados Festival was to celebrate a rich harvest.
scripts.translation:
[敲鼓的年輕人]
我不太記得確切細節了，但據說彩繪節是為了慶祝豐收。

scripts.text: ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH-
scripts.translation: 咚-噠-嗒- 咚-噠-嗒-

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
I always get energetic when I hear drums and sticks in a rhythmic beat.
scripts.translation:
[打拍子的男孩]
每當聽到鼓棒敲擊出有節奏的鼓點，我總是會充滿活力。

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH- So much fun!
scripts.translation:
[打拍子的男孩]
咚-噠-嗒- 咚-噠-嗒- 太好玩了！

scripts.text: ba-dum-TSH- ba-dum-TSH-
scripts.translation: 咚-噠-嗒- 咚-噠-嗒-

scripts.text:
[Beat Catching Boy]
I may be using sticks to catch the beat right now but you never know if I'll grow big enough to play the drums, right?
scripts.translation:
[打拍子的男孩]
我現在雖然是用鼓棒打拍子，但說不定以後長大了就能打鼓了呢，對吧？
